506.author: hsliuustc0106
506.body:
The evaluation contract job can spend its entire timeout in Git checkout on the self-hosted runners. PR #501 hit repeated connection resets before its tests could start.

Download the exact source commit through the same GitHub archive route used by server regressions, allow time for a slow connection, and record that commit in the evaluation report when the archive has no Git metadata. Cap the download and all retries at 20 minutes, with a 10-second termination grace, so the 25-minute job has time for the tests and failure summary.

Refs #501.

Validation:
- [Self-hosted evaluation workflow](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/41634773393) passed on the current commit: 47 self-tests, 11 task contracts, and both replay tasks passed.
- `node --test tests/eval/eval.test.mjs tests/unit/ci-gate.test.mjs` (57 passed).
- Exercised the download and summary scripts with a local archive and a scaled stalled-transfer timeout; extraction succeeded and the failure summary was produced. Confirmed the total timeout also interrupts curl's retry backoff.
- Ran the self-tests, task validation, and replay tasks from a local archive without `.git` and verified the recorded commit.
- `git diff --check`

508.author: Jun-Eric
508.body: ## 背景 服务端把模型输出的工具调用原文当成回复正文下发时（工具未注册 / 解析失败）， 客户端三条文本落地路径都不做过滤，用户会在气泡里直接读到： <|DSML|calls> <|DSML|invoke name="native_read_source"> <|DSML|parameter name="source_id" string="true">attachment-c8665… 现象见 #330（真机截图：只发「你好」就打出整段协议原文），历史记录里已存的原文 在冷启动/切会话后还会再显示一次。 ## 改动 新增 `CloudProtocolText`，把协议文本在"进入气泡"之前去掉，并接进三条路径： | 落地路径 | 处理 | | --- | --- | | `CloudSession.flush()` 流式分片 | 有状态过滤：跨 delta 的信封拼完整后整体丢弃 | | `applyFinalAnswer()` 非流式 final | 整段剥离，patch / replace_turn / append 三种模式均覆盖 | | `applyHistory()` 冷启动/切会话历史 | 历史里已存的泄漏原文同样不再显示 | 过滤规则刻意收窄，避免误删正常文本： - 只认 DSML 信封（`<|DSML|…>`，含截图中带空格的 `< | DSML |` 写法）和一份封闭的 已知 pipe 标签名单（`tool_call`、`endoftext`、`im_start` 等）； - 分片末尾可能是协议开头的碎片（`<`、`<|DS`）先扣住，下一片再判断，轮次结束仍未 闭合则丢弃； - ``、`1 < 2`、`a | b` 这类普通文本原样保留。 ## 验证 - Node 回归 `tests/unit/cloud-reply-protocol-text.test.mjs`：11/11 通过 （整段 / 跨分片 / 未闭合 / final / append / 历史 / 误删保护 / 裸控制符）。 该用例在修复前先失败 6 条，可复现原始泄漏。 - 相关既有单测无回归（cloud-chat 157、gateway-cloud-ui 78、cloud-auth 35 等 16 个文件全绿）。 - HarmonyOS 构建（entry + ohosTest，ArkTS 严格编译）通过。 - 模拟器（hdc `127.0.0.1:5555`）安装后实测： - 设备侧 Hypium 用例 `cloudReplyProtocolText`：`Tests run: 6, Failure: 0, Pass: 6`； - 登录后驱动真实 UI 走完一轮云端对话（图片/工具场景）并恢复历史， 气泡只有自然语言，dumpLayout 全屏扫描协议串命中 0。 ## 说明与风险 - 本 PR 只做客户端防线 - 已知取舍：用户若在会话里刻意引用闭合的 `<|DSML|…>` 原文（例如讲解协议语法）， 该段会被静默删除。需要放行代码块时可以后续再加。 - 未闭合的信封会吞掉该轮剩余文本（按"绝不显示半截协议"的取舍）。 - 不改协议、不加依赖、不记录 prompt/response 正文；工具调用失败仍走原有错误卡片。 Closes #330 Closes #395

509.author: niuypei
509.body:
Refs #505. This PR covers the initial removal and module relocation phase of the broader backend refactoring plan. Class-level decomposition and delivery acceptance remain tracked by the RFC.

This PR targets the new `refactor/backend` integration branch, created at `8cc72139`. App connection implementations are retained. The `main` branch is unchanged.

DigitalMate business tasks now select one primary Agent. Product Teams, independent Agent delegation, cross-Agent review, Agent handoff and automatic Agent relay within a room are removed. WorkSwarm's executor-internal subagents, user questions, tool approvals, App connections and human collaboration remain available.

### Changes

- Replace business delegation with `user.ask` for questions to the user. The legacy `agent.ask` action accepts only the user/person recipient. Historical Team/delegation records remain readable but cannot execute, resume, reroute into active work or reuse a Team session.
- Keep internal subagent events separate from the primary reply. A child's completion or error cannot prematurely close the main stream; normal primary completion and errors still settle the task.
- Move the product backend to `backend/src/digitalmate_backend/{server,application,harness,workspace,memory,source,contracts,shared,adapters}`. Extract shared record/ID primitives and the location contract, update imports and package resources, and add import-boundary checks.
- Split wire types/resources into `packages/protocol`; `packages/core` keeps client helpers and depends on protocol. Update deployment, startup, packaging and CI paths.
- Move pinned WorkSwarm and agent-core sources to `vendor`. All **2,771 + 2,894 source files, Git object IDs and executable modes match the existing manifests**. The platform implementation is unchanged.
- Remove hidden phone Team entries and background Team recommendations. There is no new visible page or layout.

### Review guide and scope

The first commit removes behavior in the original layout; the second establishes the module layout. Most changed files are byte-identical vendor moves. See `docs/developer_guide/backend-modules.md` for responsibilities and `backend-module-map.csv` for old/new file locations and extraction reasons.

This is the deletion and initial module migration step. `EngineService`, models colocated with `EngineStore`, and grouped stage records remain explicit migration facades; this PR does not claim their full class-level decomposition. No plugin loader or JiuwenSwarm plugin integration is introduced. Existing database transaction boundaries and memory coordination are retained.

### Validation

- Migrated business regression selection: **447 passed, 132 subtests passed, 4 deselected**.
- Credential-free server/fake Gateway regression runner: **55 tests passed**.
- Primary-Agent boundaries, historical workflow rejection, artifacts and installable package tests: **59 passed, 9 subtests passed**.
- Location/artifact/room/primary-Agent regression selection: **56 passed**.
- `npm run typecheck` and Core tests: **24 passed**; focused phone skill tests: **18 passed**.
- Vendor/deployment path tests: **12 passed**; runtime wheel contracts: **4 passed**; import-linter: **3 contracts kept**.
- Backend wheel built from the final local project; imports and packaged resources verified from an extracted wheel outside the source tree. Vendor source verification and staged object/mode comparison passed. `git diff --check` passed.

Validation uses temporary local stores and fake Gateways. No live model, container deployment or phone-device acceptance was run. The inherited full Python suite is not green at base `8cc72139` (obsolete executor/settings fixtures and optional SDK dependencies); the focused suites above are the verified scope. Two pre-existing undefined-name findings remain in `_history_directory_key` (`project_key_for_directory`) and `_gate_confirm` (`device_change_arguments`), reproduced on the clean upstream baseline.

### Follow-up validation

At head `f9b04e47`, the HarmonyOS package built successfully and was installed in a separate local emulator; startup reached the login screen. Workflow contracts passed 14/14 and workflow-driver unit tests passed 51/51. No Nightly E2E case ran, no refactored cloud backend was deployed, and this does not establish end-to-end acceptance.

509.title: refactor(backend): retire team flows and establish module boundaries

511.author: qq56734
511.body:
## What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

## What does this PR do / why do we need it

客户端侧四处 P0/P1 缺陷 + 一道防复发的门禁。全部限定在 `digitalmate/entry`、`digitalmate/cloud-adapter`、`scripts`、`tests`，不涉及 `harness/`，与进行中的模块化重构零耦合（`digitalmate/` 在重构基线 `2336d5b236fe` 与 `openjiuwen/main` `7fbaa283` 之间字节完全一致）。

**这一个 PR 只有一个 commit。** 上一版拆成了 5 个，已按要求压平。

| 改动 | issue |
|---|---|
| 失败状态统一分类 | #291, #367 |
| 登录页错误可感知 | #452 |
| 任务卡片点击区可命名 | #455 |
| a11y 静态门禁 | 防复发，无对应 issue |

---

### 1. 失败状态统一分类（#291, #367）

同一次失败原本被判断三遍：`isModelFailure()` 决定「算不算失败」，`digitalmateTaskFailureText()` 决定「怎么说」，通知模块再把文案从会话层 import 回去。三者各自只认识云端返回的一小部分形态，表里没登记的失败一律掉进「任务执行失败」，哪怕云端已经说清了原因。

现在这张表只有一份，在 `DigitalMateStatus.ets`。`digitalmateTaskFailureText()` 保留为文案入口，调用方和既有措辞都不动。

补上三类此前叫不出名字的失败：

- **`no_answer`** — 云端会说「这一轮结束了，但没有给出回答」。这句话在整个端侧出现 **0 次**，这类轮次被当成通用执行失败上报。客户端早就有对应文案，但被 `text === 'waiting' && status === 'completed'` 卡住，云端的这句话永远匹配不上（#291）。
- **`tool`** — 本轮依赖的工具失败，与模型调用失败不同。
- **`service`** — 执行服务本身不可用，处置方式与凭据问题完全不同。

`unknown` 刻意不猜原因。猜错比不猜更糟。

同时失败行不再产出 `replyTarget`。这道防护原本只写在视图里（`DigitalMateHome/Index.ets:3343` 在 assistant 分支内判断），别的渲染器继承不到；把失败内容引用回上下文，正是「一次失败连带后续失败」的形成路径（#367）。

**措辞约束**：真实失败产生的每一句都保留了 `tests/e2e/workflow/driver.mjs:33` 会匹配的词，坏的轮次仍会让设备步骤失败，不会看起来像一次正常完成的回复。`interrupted` 是唯一例外，用户主动取消不该被判为失败。

### 2. 登录页错误可感知（#452）

错误文案原本拼在最后一个按钮之后：屏幕阅读器用户按完「登录」焦点还停在按钮上，原因出现在下方够不到、也不播报。改动前整个仓库 `sendAccessibilityEvent` 调用数为 **0**。

- 错误改为只渲染一次，位于标题正下方、所有控件之上，`accessibilityGroup(true)` + `focusable(true)`，标签为「登录失败：<原因>」
- 播报挂在 `@Watch('errorChanged')` 上、绑在状态字段本身而非逐个失败分支：所有会失败的路径本来就会写这个字段，一次监听全覆盖，将来新增分支也不会漏
- 播报后把焦点移到错误区；只播报不移动焦点的话，用户仍要自己找
- 勾选提示原本是 `showToast`——由窗口管理器绘制、根本不进无障碍树，屏幕阅读器完全读不到。改为走同一个可见可播报通道，底部重复渲染一并删除（同一句话渲染两遍会被播报两次，还会拆成两个可读节点）

`a11y/AccessibilityAnnounce.ets` 是封装：先查 `isOpenAccessibilitySync()`（没有无障碍服务在跑时，每次错误都发一条是纯浪费 IPC），并吞掉自身异常——播报绝不能弄坏它正在描述的那条流程。

### 3. 任务卡片点击区可命名（#455）

卡片把 7 个 `onClick` 挂在裸 `Text`/`Row` 上，无障碍属性为 **0**。屏幕阅读器只会念「0 执行中」「0 提醒」「更新于 09:12」，没有任何信息说明这些字可点、点了去哪。应用内用户可以试错探索，但卡片是独立表面，没有周边语境可依。

7 个点击区全部补上 `accessibilityText`；头像 `Image` 标为装饰，因为旁边的 `Text('Beebou')` 已表达同样信息，两个都播会念两遍。

文案抽到 `DigitalMateTaskCardA11y.ets`，可脱离设备断言，且指标名与可见文案取自同一份数字。

### 4. a11y 静态门禁（防复发）

2026-11 基线：385 个 `onClick` 对 78 个 `accessibilityText`。评审没有任何环节发现这个差距，因为缺标签在 diff 里看不出来，在没有屏幕阅读器的设备上也是静默的。

规则刻意收窄，因为吵的检查会被删掉而不是被修好。只报**可证明**无法从自身内容获得名称的组件：容器（`Row`/`Column`/`Stack`/`Flex`/`Scroll`/`ListItem`…）和裸图形（`Image`/`Rect`/`Circle`/`Path`…）。这类组件带 `onClick` 时必须具备 `accessibilityText`、`accessibilityGroup(true)`、`accessibilityLevel('no')` 或 `accessibilityDescription` 之一。

`Button('登录')`、`Text`、自定义组件不报——它们自带文本。可点的 `Text` 正是 #455 的形态，但裸 `Text` 会带着内容被朗读，缺陷是语义的而非结构的，无法在不误报每一个合法可点词的前提下检出；那种情况由 `DigitalMateTaskCardA11y` 及其测试覆盖。

解析器从每个 `onClick` **向后**走到它所属的组件。向前走必须猜子节点块在哪结束；向后走，嵌套关系自然得出。两个细节是承重的、且有测试覆盖：剥注释时要跳过字符串（粗暴地按 `//` 剥会把 URL 弄坏，之后所有花括号配平失效，文件被静默报告为干净）；修饰符要在 `onClick` 两侧都收集（写在前面或后面都合法，仓库里两种都有）。

存量债务记在 `tests/unit/a11y-baseline.json`，只允许减少。基线过期同样报错，否则修好一个文件却忘了更新基线，它就能悄悄退回旧数字。

当前 28 个文件在基线内，新增或变差 **0**。

---

## 真机验证

签名 entry HAP 安装到 HarmonyOS 真机（`JDY-AL50` / API 26）后的实测。

**构建过程本身发现了两个单测看不见的问题**（已在本 commit 内修复）：

1. `DigitalMateTaskCardA11y` 的 import 路径写成 `./`，而 helper 在 `taskcard/`、卡片在 `taskcard/pages/`，必须 `../`。没有任何单测解析 ArkTS import，这个错误只在打包时才暴露。
2. 打包阶段需要 JDK，`spawn java ENOENT`。

### #452 登录页错误提示

未勾选同意时点「获取验证码」：

| 状态 | 截图 |
|---|---|
| 错误出现在标题正下方、所有控件之上 | ![错误可见](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/35837a43/docs/developer_guide/validation/issue-452-455-device-20261103/01-consent-error-visible.png?raw=true) |
| 勾选后自动清除，回到常态 | ![勾选后清除](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/35837a43/docs/developer_guide/validation/issue-452-455-device-20261103/02-consent-ticked-error-cleared.png?raw=true) |

布局树实测：错误区 `id=account-login-error`，bounds `[84,570][996,690]`，位于标题（y≈150）与手机号输入框（y≈770）之间；勾选后该节点从树中消失。这验证了错误与勾选共用同一条通道，而不是各自静默。

### #455 任务卡片标签（真机推翻了第一版实现）

第一版用 `accessibilityText`，且只用单测与字节码验证过就写进了 PR。真机取控件树后发现**这个属性在桌面卡片里根本不生效**：

| | 可见文字 `text` | 可读描述 `desc` |
|---|---|---|
| 改前（`accessibilityText`） | `0 执行中` | `''` |
| 改后（`accessibilityDescription`） | `0 执行中` | `执行中 0 项，打开活动列表` |

`accessibilityText` 被忽略，可读名称退化成可见文字，去向说明整个丢失；`accessibilityDescription` 才进得了桌面的控件树。系统自带时钟卡片是同一形态（`text='09, :, 16'` + `desc='长按时间切换显示格式'`），正好作为参照。

根因：卡片由**桌面进程**渲染，不是应用进程。两个属性虽然都标了 `@form`，但只有 description 穿过这条边界。这一点在任何应用自己能控制的运行时里都看不出来——预览和单测两种写法都通过。

改成 `accessibilityDescription` 后的实测结果（5 个点击区，`desc` 全部就位）：

| 点击区 | 读出的描述 |
|---|---|
| 头像行 | `Beebou，打开活动列表` |
| 标题列 | `Real device smoke 1135，最近完成，打开查看` |
| 执行中 | `执行中 0 项，打开活动列表` |
| 提醒 | `0 条提醒，打开提醒列表` |
| 时间 | `更新于 21:07，打开活动列表` |

![任务卡片](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/35837a43/docs/developer_guide/validation/issue-452-455-device-20261103/03-task-card.png?raw=true)

卡片视觉零变化——无障碍改动本就不该动像素。

新增 `tests/unit/digitalmate-task-card-a11y.test.mjs`（5 条）锁住这个结论，其中一条专门断言「不得出现 `accessibilityText`」，反向验证过：改回旧写法会精确失败在这一条。

**仍未覆盖**：设备没有安装屏幕阅读器，所以「实际播报的语音」这一层没有录音证据；控件树里的 `desc` 是桌面提供给无障碍服务的名称，已是该层能拿到的最直接证据。

---

## 验证

**单测**（全绿）：`digitalmate-adapter` 59、`digitalmate-notifications` 72、`digitalmate-user-text` 10、`digitalmate-status` 10（新增）、`a11y-gate` 20（新增）、`digitalmate-task-card` 11、`account-login-scenarios` 4、`user-management-huawei-binding` 16、`settings-account-layout` 4、`digitalmate-message-actions` 15、`digitalmate-parallel-topics` 21、`digitalmate-topic-async` 4。

**全量回归**：与 `openjiuwen/main` `7fbaa283` 在干净 worktree 上逐文件跑 `tests/unit/*.test.mjs`，失败集合完全相同（13 个预先存在的环境类问题），零新增。

**CI**：`node-ut` pass、`ArkTS Code Check` pass。

**门禁自检**：`28 known, 0 new or worse, 0 stale`。反向验证过：临时注入一个裸 `Row().onClick`，门禁退出码变 1 并精确指出 `tappable Row node(s) with no accessible name — not in baseline`；还原后回到 0。

**构建**：`cloud_adapter` HAR 与 `entry` HAP 均 `BUILD SUCCESSFUL`。

## 需要 reviewer 注意

1. **`digitalmateStatusText('interrupted')` 故意不匹配 e2e 的 `FAILURE` 正则**。如果你们的语义是「取消也算未完成」，这条要改回来。
2. **门禁的 28 个基线文件是存量债务**，本次没清。要清建议单独 PR。
3. **卡片运行时朗读未在真机确认**（见上文）。

## 后续（另开）

- #457、#464：待处理卡片不会因为用户发新消息而失效（`pendingInteractions()` 只过滤 `status === 'waiting'`，无过期）
- #458、#344、#374：展示层

Closes #291
Closes #367
Closes #452
Closes #455

513.author: HugoXK
513.body: ## What The aggregate-search renderer treated any `http(s)` address as a valid source, so `https://a.com@evil.test/y` rendered as a clickable source button and as the "打开原文" preview, while the WebView/browser lands on `evil.test`. The host that receives the click was never checked. ## Fix - `validSourceUrl()` now also rejects an address whose authority carries userinfo (`url.username || url.password`). It is the single gate behind three consumers: the card source anchor, `normalizedRelatedUrl()`, and the related-image filter — including the `coverUrl` fallback, which used to bypass it. - The aggregate post preview is built outside the template by `renderPostLink()`, which wrote the row URL into `href` with no check at all (`javascript:` included). It now goes through a named `safeExternalUrl()` helper using the repository's existing predicate from `workers/WaterfallPoolWorker.ets:429` (http(s) only, no userinfo in the authority). - An `@` inside the path (`https://a.com/x@evil.test`) is not userinfo and keeps working. The template string runs in the WebView, `renderPostLink()` is ArkTS: the template function is not reachable from native code, so the **same judgement exists once per runtime, as two implementations** — not one shared implementation. The divergence is listed below. ## Files - `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/html/HtmlAggregateSearchHomeRenderer.ets` **+12/−2** - `tests/unit/aggregate-search-link-userinfo.test.mjs` **+144/−0** (new independent test file; the existing `waterfall-renderer-interaction.test.mjs` is untouched and still passes) ## Evidence Red on the unmodified `main` tree (`8cc7213`), module byte-identical to main, only the new test file added: ``` $ node --test tests/unit/aggregate-search-link-userinfo.test.mjs ✖ validSourceUrl rejects a host that is not the one in the address bar ✖ the card source anchor is not rendered for a userinfo address ✖ normalizedRelatedUrl drops a userinfo address and keeps an ordinary one ✖ related markup filters a userinfo image and keeps an ordinary one ✖ the aggregate post link preview does not link to a userinfo address ℹ tests 5 / pass 0 / fail 5 ``` After the fix commits (`7ea044c8`, `4e44321e`): ``` $ node --test tests/unit/aggregate-search-link-userinfo.test.mjs ℹ tests 5 / pass 5 / fail 0 $ node --test tests/unit/waterfall-renderer-interaction.test.mjs ℹ tests 1 / pass 1 / fail 0 ``` Mutation checks (each reverted afterwards): | mutation | result | |---|---| | delete `if (url.username || url.password) return false;` | 4 template blocks red, native block green | | `renderPostLink`: `safeExternalUrl(postLinkUrl(block))` → `postLinkUrl(block)` | only `the aggregate post link preview does not link to a userinfo address` red | | `relatedMarkup`: `validSourceUrl(item.coverUrl) ? … : ''` → `item.coverUrl` | only `related markup filters a userinfo image and keeps an ordinary one` red (5/4/1) | Reverse guards: `https://a.com/x`, `http://a.com`, `https://a.com/x@evil.test` stay valid and still render; `javascript:alert(1)` is rejected on both halves; an ordinary `coverUrl` still renders. ## Known residual: the two implementations diverge on 4 malformed inputs A 24-case truth table run against both shipped implementations (job output, not copied code) found 4 divergences: | input | template `validSourceUrl` | native `safeExternalUrl` | |---|---|---| | `https://@evil.test/y` | true (empty userinfo; host evil.test, label also shows evil.test) | false | | `https://a.com%40evil.test/x` | **false** (WHATWG parser rejects the invalid host) | **true** | | `https:a.com/x` | true (normalised to `https://a.com/x`) | false | | `https://a.com\@evil.test/x` | true (`\` treated as `/`, host stays a.com) | false | Three are the native half being **stricter** (a rare malformed address loses its link; the safe direction). The only looser case is `https://a.com%40evil.test/x`: the native regex accepts it, but the WebView's WHATWG parser rejects it as an invalid host and does not navigate (Node's `URL`, same spec, throws `Invalid URL`). Merging the two fully would require `@ohos.url` on the native side; out of scope here. ## Not covered here - Shared JSON corpus pinning both implementations to one list of URLs (review point 3, self-marked non-blocking): it needs a new corpus file plus both harnesses rewritten, beyond one issue / one PR → follow-up after #512. - The other `coverUrl` → `` sinks in this renderer (`:2958`, `:4791`, `:4870`, `:2913`) and `renderEmbed()`'s `embedUrl`/`thumbnail` → ``/`
513.head: fix/aggregate-search-userinfo-links
513.title: fix(entry): reject userinfo source links in the aggregate search renderer

514.body:
> 准备合入；CI 通过后请人工确认再合并。

本 PR 是 #400 的增量：#400 已合入 `main`（merge commit `9cd6dc62`）。本分支仍包含 #400 的历史提交，**update/rebase 到最新 `main` 后**，本 PR 的实际 diff 是 **7 个提交、6 个文件**：

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
- `docs/developer_guide/ci.md`
- `scripts/README.md`
- `scripts/ci/hypium-ut.ps1`（新增）
- `scripts/ci/st.ps1`（新增）
- `tests/unit/ci-gate.test.mjs`

## 为什么

`pr-ready` 的 `hypium-ut` 和 `st` 原本跑在 macOS `harmonyos`（`/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app`），而 DevEco Studio、HarmonyOS SDK 和模拟器镜像都在 Windows 设备机上。把这两条 suite 移到 Windows 设备机后，PR 门禁不再依赖那台 Mac。

## 改了什么

**`.github/workflows/ci.yml`** — `hypium-ut` / `st` 两个 job：

- `runs-on: [self-hosted, Windows, X64, hypium-windows, harmony-device]`。`harmony-device` 是新标签，用来区分“有 DevEco + 模拟器镜像”的主机；只写 `hypium-windows` 会被另一台没有模拟器的 Windows runner 接走（实测过）。
- 步骤换 PowerShell（`shell: powershell -File {0}`），源码仍走 REST tarball（`curl.exe` + `tar.exe`），不使用 `actions/checkout`。
- workspace 清理容忍枚举与删除之间的竞态和 MAX_PATH 超长路径：原来的 `Get-ChildItem | Remove-Item` 会因为一个文件已被删掉而整步失败。
- `DEVECO_HOME` 变成可选覆盖，默认交给脚本探测。

**`scripts/ci/hypium-ut.ps1`（新增）** — `hypium-ut.sh` 的 Windows 版本：`ohpm install --all` → `hvigorw test` → 校验 `test_result.txt` 的 `Tests run: N, Failure: 0, Error: 0`（hvigor 用例失败也返回 0，所以必须看结果文件）。

**`scripts/ci/st.ps1`（新增）** — `st.sh` 的 Windows 版本：复用或拉起 `127.0.0.1` 模拟器，然后委托 `run-digitalmate-device-st.ps1 -AttachmentPolicy -Run`（免凭据的 attachment-policy suite）。

两个脚本都按“显式参数 → `DEVECO_HOME` → 已知布局（`D:\DevEco Studio`、`D:\Tools\DevEco Studio`、`%ProgramFiles%\Huawei\DevEco Studio`）”探测 DevEco 根目录：现有两台 Windows runner 的安装路径就不一样。

**文档 / 测试**：`docs/developer_guide/ci.md`、`scripts/README.md` 同步；`tests/unit/ci-gate.test.mjs` 的 runner 断言更新。

## 验证

本机（`digitalmate-win-st-01`，DevEco `D:\DevEco Studio`，模拟器 `Mate 90 Pro`）：

```
scripts\ci\hypium-ut.ps1   → Tests run: 2295, Failure: 0, Error: 0, Pass: 2295  (49s)
scripts\ci\st.ps1          → 5/5 通过, junit tests=5 failures=0              (14s)
node --test tests/unit/ci-gate.test.mjs tests/unit/pr-ready-report.test.mjs tests/unit/issue-workflows.test.mjs → 44 pass
```

GitHub 侧（`workflow_dispatch --ref ci/windows-lane-verify`，run `41638659034`）全部通过：

```
pr-ready-node-ut      ✅ success  dm-cloud-nodeut-01
pr-ready-hypium-ut    ✅ success  digitalmate-win-st-01
pr-ready-st           ✅ success  digitalmate-win-st-01
pr-ready-report       ✅ success
```

## 注意

- 本 PR 仍为 draft；合入前需要 update/rebase 到最新 `main`，把 diff 收敛到上面的 7 个提交。
- `pull_request_target` 使用 base 分支的 workflow，所以在本 PR 上标 ready 跑的是 `main` 的 macOS 门禁，不是这里的 Windows lane；Windows lane 已用 `workflow_dispatch` 在分支上验证。合入后，后续 PR 才会走 Windows lane。
- 当前 `server-regression` 仍失败，原因是 `main` 的 `server-regression.yml` 从 `bootstrap.pypa.io` 下载 `get-pip.py` 超时（exit 28），与本 PR 的 Windows lane 改动无关。
- 不要自动合入。

516.author: qq56734
516.body:
## What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

## What does this PR do / why do we need it

A failed login was painted below the last button. A screen reader user who pressed 「登录」 stayed focused on that button, and the reason appeared further down a page they had no cue to leave. Before this change the repository contained **zero** calls to `sendAccessibilityEvent`.

- The message renders once, under the title and above every control, as a group that can take focus, labelled `登录失败：<原因>`.
- It is announced through `@Watch('errorChanged')` on the state field itself rather than per failure branch: every failing path already writes that field, so one watch covers all of them and a future branch cannot forget to announce.

### A watch alone was not enough

`@Watch` fires only when the decorated value actually changes — ArkUI compares with strict equality ([official rule](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/HarmonyOS-Guides/arkts-watch)). Repeating the same rejection — pressing 「获取验证码」 twice with the consent box still unticked — wrote `CONSENT_MESSAGE` over an identical string, no watch fired, and **the second press was silent**: no announcement, no focus move.

`consent()` now detects that case and announces inline, so every rejected action is acknowledged. It announces only when the message was unchanged; when it did change, the watch already speaks and calling it again would say the same sentence twice.

### Focus goes through the accessibility channel

The previous version moved focus with `focusControl.requestFocus`. That requests **ordinary input focus**: it takes the caret away from whatever field the user is typing in, and nothing guarantees a screen reader follows it. It also implied a focus move that was never verified.

The platform event is `EventType 'requestFocusForAccessibility'` (`@since 12`) with `EventInfo.customId`, documented in this SDK as *"Component ID for active focusing"*. The event is posted after layout completes so it targets a node that exists, and only while `isOpenAccessibilitySync()` is true — so it neither wastes IPC nor claims a move that did not happen.

`AccessibilityAnnounce.ets` now exposes `focusForAccessibility(componentId, text)`. The consent prompt moved off `showToast` too: a toast is drawn by the window manager, never enters the accessibility tree, and was completely silent.

## Verification

**Unit** — `tests/unit/account-login-repeat-rejection.test.mjs` (6 tests) runs the **real `consent()` body** in a stand-in instance whose `@Watch` is modelled faithfully (fires only on a real change), so the repeat case genuinely reproduces the defect. Flipping back to the old implementation makes exactly 2 of them fail; restoring the fix returns 6/6.

Also asserts: `focusControl.requestFocus` never appears; the event type and `customId` are the accessibility ones; the `customId` matches the `.id()` the template renders.

- `account-login-repeat-rejection` 6 pass, `account-login-scenarios` 4 pass, `user-management-huawei-binding` 16 pass, `settings-account-layout` 4 pass
- Full suite on this branch: **2289 pass / 2 fail** — the same 2 environment failures that clean `openjiuwen/main` has (2283 pass / 2 fail). Zero new.
- `entry` HAP: **BUILD SUCCESSFUL**

**Device** (`JDY-AL50`, API 26). Tapping 「获取验证码」 with the consent box unticked:

| State | Screenshot |
|---|---|
| Error sits under the title, above every control | ![error visible](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/5bc8d6e9/docs/developer_guide/validation/issue-452-455-device-20261103/01-consent-error-visible.png?raw=true) |
| Ticking the box clears it | ![cleared](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/5bc8d6e9/docs/developer_guide/validation/issue-452-455-device-20261103/02-consent-ticked-error-cleared.png?raw=true) |

The widget dump shows `id=account-login-error` at bounds `[84,570][996,690]`, between the title (y≈150) and the phone input (y≈770); ticking the box removes the node from the tree. That proves the error and the consent prompt share one channel instead of each having a silent one.

### What is not verified

**The device has no screen reader installed.** So the spoken utterance and the resulting focus position are **not** observed — this PR does not claim them. What is evidenced is the widget tree, and in source that the platform's focus event is posted with the component id the template renders. Event/tree evidence ≠ audio/focus evidence, and the gap is stated rather than papered over.

Closes #452
516.head: fix/452-login-error-a11y
516.title: fix(entry): announce every rejected login action and use accessibility focus

517.author: qq56734
517.body:
## What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

## What does this PR do / why do we need it

The home-screen task card hung seven `onClick` handlers on bare `Text`/`Row` nodes with **no** accessible name. A screen reader read the visible words only — `0 执行中`, `0 提醒`, `更新于 09:12` — so nothing said they were tappable or where a tap would land. Inside the app a user can explore by trial and error; the card is a standalone surface with no surrounding context to fall back on.

All seven targets are named. The avatar image is marked decorative because the `Text` beside it already says `Beebou` — reading both says the name twice.

### The attribute is `accessibilityDescription`, not `accessibilityText`

Not a preference, and the reason this PR took two attempts. Verified on a HarmonyOS device (`JDY-AL50`, API 26):

| | visible `text` | readable `desc` |
|---|---|---|
| before (`accessibilityText`) | `0 执行中` | `''` |
| after (`accessibilityDescription`) | `0 执行中` | `执行中 0 项，打开活动列表` |

With `accessibilityText` the launcher's widget dump still reported the visible words as the readable name and **every** description field stayed empty, so the destination was lost entirely. Only `accessibilityDescription` crosses into the dump.

The card is rendered by the **launcher**, not by the app. Both attributes are declared `@form`, but only the description survives that boundary. The stock clock widget has the same shape — `text='09, :, 16'` plus `desc='长按时间切换显示格式'`.

**This difference is invisible in every runtime the app controls.** A preview passes, an in-app test passes, and the strings are in the compiled bytecode with either attribute — the first version shipped with `accessibilityText` and all its unit tests passed. Only the device's widget dump shows it.

Measured after the change:

| tap target | read out |
|---|---|
| avatar row | `Beebou，打开活动列表` |
| title column | `Real device smoke 1135，最近完成，打开查看` |
| running count | `执行中 0 项，打开活动列表` |
| reminders | `0 条提醒，打开提醒列表` |
| footer | `更新于 21:07，打开活动列表` |

![task card](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/9d19823d/docs/developer_guide/validation/issue-452-455-device-20261103/03-task-card.png?raw=true)

The card looks identical — an accessibility change should not move pixels. `tests/unit/digitalmate-task-card-a11y.test.mjs` (5 tests) locks the conclusion, including one forbidding `accessibilityText` in this file; verified by flipping it back and watching exactly that test fail.

## The gate, and a bug in the gate's own test

2026-11 baseline: 385 taps against 78 labels. No review step could see that gap — a missing label is invisible in a diff and silent on a device without a screen reader.

The rule is deliberately narrow, because a noisy check gets deleted rather than fixed. It reports only components that provably cannot name themselves from their own content: containers (`Row`/`Column`/`Stack`/`Flex`/`Scroll`/`ListItem`…) and bare shapes (`Image`/`Rect`/`Circle`/`Path`…). `Button('登录')`, `Text` and custom components are not reported — they carry text, and whether that text is good is a review question, not a lint one.

The parser walks **backwards** from each `onClick` to the component that owns it. Walking forwards has to guess where a child block ends; walking backwards, nesting falls out. Stripping comments has to skip strings (a naive `//` strip mangles a URL, after which brace matching is wrong and the file is reported clean), and modifiers may sit on either side of `onClick`.

### The gate test was scanning the wrong directory

`a11y-gate.test.mjs` resolved the root with `new URL('..', root)` — but `root` **already is** the repository root (the file lives in `tests/unit/`). Resolving `..` from it landed in `.worktrees/`, the parent of the checkout, where `scan()` finds no ArkTS file at all. The suite then compared **0 findings against 0 baseline entries and passed**, proving nothing.

| root | files | tap targets | unnamed | baseline entries |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| correct (`root`) | 28 | 272 | 96 | 28 |
| parent (`new URL('..', root)`) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

Both read as "clean". The path is now `fileURLToPath(root)`.

Fixing only the path would leave the trap for the next person, so the comparison is preceded by guards that fail when the scan comes back empty or inconsistent:

- the repository root must exist
- the scan must return **≥ 20 files** and **≥ 200 tap targets** (measured 272; the floor is deliberately well under it so ordinary growth still passes)
- the baseline must load **≥ 20 entries**
- **every baselined path must be one the scan actually returned** — a root one level off produces disjoint key spaces, which compares clean

Two tests pin the reasoning rather than a directory name: one demonstrates that an empty scan makes both comparisons vacuously true, the other proves a bare tappable `Row` with no name is still reported as `not in baseline`.

**Verified by restoring the bug**: the guards fail on exactly those tests, and pass again once the path is corrected.

**Verified end to end**: adding an unnamed `Row` to the tree makes `scripts/check-a11y.mjs` exit 1 with `29 known, 1 new or worse`; removing it returns to `28 known, 0 new or worse, 0 stale`.

## Verification

- `a11y-gate` **22 pass** (was 20), `digitalmate-task-card-a11y` 5 pass, `digitalmate-task-card` 11 pass
- Full suite on this branch: **2310 pass / 2 fail** — the same 2 environment failures clean `openjiuwen/main` has. Zero new.
- `entry` HAP: **BUILD SUCCESSFUL**

## Note on scope

This branch does **not** touch the login page or the cloud-adapter failure classification. #452 is its own PR; #291/#367 are still unverified on device and are not included here.

Closes #455
517.head: fix/455-task-card-a11y
517.title: fix(entry): name every tap target on the home-screen task card

519.author: HugoXK
519.body:
## What this fixes

`popupTitleFromUrl()` decided the popup title by searching the **whole URL** for provider names (`indexOf('google')`, `indexOf('paypal')`, `indexOf('checkout.stripe.com/')`, `indexOf('alipay')`), and `popupSubtitleFromTitle()` then gave every non-neutral title the subtitle **`安全确认页面`**. A page could therefore borrow a provider label with a longer domain label, a userinfo authority, a path or a query string, while the popup has no address bar to correct it:

```
https://notpaypal.com/                       -> "PayPal 确认"     / "安全确认页面"
https://www.paypal.com@evil.test/checkout    -> "PayPal 确认"     / "安全确认页面"
https://paypal.com:443@evil.test/checkout    -> "PayPal 确认"     / "安全确认页面"
https://evil.test/?ref=google                -> "Google Pay 确认" / "安全确认页面"
https://evil.test/checkout.stripe.com/pay/x  -> "支付确认"        / "安全确认页面"
```

Fixes #518.

## Change

One function in `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/components/HtmlHomeSurfaceView.ets`: parse the authority, reject anything that is not `http(s)`, has userinfo, is an IPv6 literal or ends with a dot, strip the port, then name a provider only when `host === domain || host.endsWith('.' + domain)`. The Google Maps branch keeps both the `maps.google.com` host and the `google.com` + `/maps/` path form; `checkout.stripe.com` stays an exact host. `popupSubtitleFromTitle()`, `shouldOpenWaterfallSourceExternally()` and the three call sites (`:181`, `:238`, `:832`) are untouched.

## Commits (4, two files, +174/−5)

1. `1460f3df` — test only (+142): slices `popupTitleFromUrl()` and `popupSubtitleFromTitle()` out of the shipped ArkTS file and executes them; red on unmodified `main`.
2. `ce401058` — the fix (+21/−5).
3. `cac7ba8b` — test only (+5): the first mutation run showed the userinfo guard was **not load-bearing**. `https://www.paypal.com@evil.test/checkout` fell back to the neutral title even with the `@` check deleted, because the allowlist alone rejects a host that still contains `@`. The case that does depend on the check is a userinfo authority **with a port**: port stripping runs after the userinfo test, so `paypal.com:443@evil.test` reduces to `paypal.com` and is labelled `PayPal 确认` again. Commit 3 pins both port forms, and deleting `authority.indexOf(@) >= 0` now fails exactly those two cases.
4. `3a3cb666` — follow-up after the bot review (+5 test, +2/−1 code): reject a backslash in the authority.

## Follow-up fix after bot review

`agent-ci-infra-bot` flagged that a special URL scheme rewrites `\` to `/`, so `https://evil.test\.paypal.com/` opens `evil.test` while the raw authority still ends with `.paypal.com` — the popup said `PayPal 确认`; `https://evil.test\.google.com/maps/x` said `Google Maps 路线` the same way. The repository already rejects such addresses in `workers/WaterfallPoolWorker.ets:429` (`[^/?#@\s\\]+`), so this file was looser than the existing policy.

The authority now also has to be free of backslashes before any provider is named. All three backslash shapes are pinned: on the previous head (`cac7ba8b`) the first two were red and `https://paypal.com\.evil.test/` was already neutral; it stays neutral, because the function does not model the backslash rewrite, it just refuses the shape.

## Evidence (all from a full unpack of `main` at `9cd6dc62`; the branch blobs match the API sha1)

```
# red: unmodified main tree + the final test file
node --test tests/unit/home-popup-title-host.test.mjs
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 3  ℹ fail 16

# green: head 3a3cb666 tree (same blobs)
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 19  ℹ fail 0

# red on the previous head cac7ba8b, before the backslash guard
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 17  ℹ fail 2
✖ https://evil.test\.paypal.com/          actual "PayPal 确认"      expected "内容详情"
✖ https://evil.test\.google.com/maps/x    actual "Google Maps 路线" expected "内容详情"

# M2 on 3a3cb666: delete the @ check
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 17  ℹ fail 2   (the two port-userinfo cases)

# M3 on 3a3cb666: host.endsWith('.paypal.com') -> host.endsWith('paypal.com')
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 18  ℹ fail 1   (https://notpaypal.com/)
```

The 16 red cases on `main` are the look-alike hosts (including `notpaypal.com`, `google.com.evil.test`, both port-userinfo forms, the backslash forms and `evil.test/checkout.stripe.com/pay/x`); the 3 passing ones are the real-provider reverse guard, the subtitle mapping guard and `https://evil.test/#checkout.stripe.com`, which is already neutral on `main` and is kept as a guard next to its red variant.

## Known behaviour change

`https://user@www.paypal.com/` changes from `PayPal 确认` to `内容详情`: any address carrying userinfo is now neutral. This is deliberate — the reader cannot see the userinfo, and the popup has no address bar.

- `https://checkout.stripe.com` (no path) changes from `内容详情` to `支付确认`: matching the exact host is wider than the old substring `checkout.stripe.com/`.
- `https://foo.checkout.stripe.com/pay` changes from `支付确认` to `内容详情`: subdomains of the checkout host are no longer accepted.
- `https://paypal.me/someone` changes from `PayPal 确认` to `内容详情`: the old substring match accepted the `paypal` token anywhere, and `paypal.me` is a different registrable domain. It is a genuine PayPal link domain, so adding it to the allowlist is a follow-up decision.
- `https://gpay.app/x` changes from `Google Pay 确认` to `内容详情`: `gpay.app` is not a Google host, so the old label was wrong; it now falls back to the neutral title.
- `https://paypal.com\` and `https://paypal.com\@evil.test/` fall back to `内容详情` even though a browser would open `paypal.com`: the contract is "any authority containing a backslash is neutral". The function refuses the shape instead of modelling the `\`-to-`/` rewrite, which is the conservative direction.

## Not covered here

- `https://evil.test%5c.paypal.com/` (percent-encoded backslash) still resolves to `PayPal 确认`: WHATWG decodes `%5C` inside the host, which makes the address invalid, so the popup loads nothing (fail-closed). Rejecting `%5c` case-insensitively in the authority would close it; recorded as a follow-up rather than added to this minimal fix.

- `https://www.google.com/search?q=1` keeps `Google Pay 确认 / 安全确认页面` before and after: the mapping is host-level, not path-level, and tightening it beyond the maps branch is a separate decision. `https://www.google.com/maps?q=1` and `https://www.google.com/maps` (path `/maps`, without the trailing slash) keep the same title for the same reason; that is pre-existing behaviour on `main`, not introduced here. Accepting them would take `path === '/maps' || path.startsWith('/maps/')`, which is a behaviour widening and is left for a follow-up issue.
- The popup still renders no URL or host anywhere (`popupUrl` is only assigned/loaded, never rendered as text), so the title remains the only site hint. Giving the sheet a host line is a follow-up.

## Who did what

- Issue text: Lead (Product did not deliver in this round).
- Failing test and the port-userinfo hardening: DigitalMate Test.
- Fix in `HtmlHomeSurfaceView.ets`: DigitalMate Dev-1.
- Integration, red/green/mutation runs and this PR: Lead.

522.body:
Fixes #521

## What this changes

`deepSearchSourceHost()` in `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/html/HtmlHomeRenderer.ets` (`HTML_HOME_JS`, `:3749-3771`) derives the domain label rendered next to every deep-search citation (`:3856`). It used to strip the scheme and cut at the first `/`, so the label kept the URL userinfo, the port, the query string and the fragment:

```
https://alice:pw@example.com/a   ->  alice:pw@example.com   (rendered as the site name)
https://user@www.paypal.com/     ->  user@www.paypal.com
https://example.com?q=1          ->  example.com?q=1
https://example.com:8443/x       ->  example.com:8443
http://[::1]:8080/x              ->  [::1]:8080
```

The function now parses the authority in a single character pass: it ends at the first `/`, `?`, `#` **or `\`**, and TAB/LF/CR are dropped instead of being kept in the label (that is what a browser does with whitespace inside a URL). After that the userinfo is dropped at the last `@`, and the port is dropped, except that an IPv6 literal keeps its brackets. The scheme test is case-insensitive, and an empty or non-http(s) input yields `''` instead of the raw value.

Only this one function changed. `openWaterfallSource()` (`:3861`), the click path and the `title || url` fallback at `:3855` are untouched.

## Red first

```
cd <tree at upstream main 1432414e> && node --test tests/unit/deep-search-source-host.test.mjs
ℹ tests 20
ℹ pass 6
ℹ fail 14
```

Six positive cases stay green there, so the red is the assertions and not a broken load. The test slices the shipped `text()` and `deepSearchSourceHost()` out of the real `.ets` (brace matching that skips string literals and comments), strips the types and runs both in a `vm` context — no copy of the implementation and no assertion on the source text.

## Green on the head

```
cd <tree at 55df4a9a> && node --test tests/unit/deep-search-source-host.test.mjs
ℹ tests 20
ℹ pass 20
ℹ fail 0
```

Related page baseline: `tests/unit/waterfall-renderer-interaction.test.mjs` `1/1`.

Whole `tests/unit` suite, same checkout pair (measured on the 17-case revision of this branch, `d45838c1`):

| tree | tests | pass | fail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| main `1432414e` | 1699 | 1657 | 35 |
| head `d45838c1` | 1716 | 1674 | 35 |

The difference is exactly the new cases, and the failing set is byte-for-byte the same 28 files on both sides — all of them stop at `Cannot find module 'typescript'` / `'playwright'`, which this sandbox does not install and CI does.

## Follow-up fix after bot review

`agent-ci-infra-bot` raised one finding (F1, medium): the authority scan stopped only at `/`, `?` and `#`, so a crafted citation could label a host the click does not open — `https://evil.test\@example.com/x` was labelled `example.com`, and `https://example.com\@evil.test/` was labelled `evil.test`.

Fixed in two commits on this branch:

- `bac3c5a2` — adds the three cases (both `\@` directions, plus a TAB inside the host), test file only.
- `55df4a9a` — the scan now also breaks on `\` (char code 92) and skips TAB/LF/CR (9/10/13).

Verified against the previous head with the same 20-case file:

```
cd <tree at d45838c1>        ℹ tests 20  pass 17  fail 3
cd <tree at 55df4a9a>        ℹ tests 20  pass 20  fail 0
```

The three red cases on `d45838c1` are exactly the F1 cases, so the new assertions pin the gap rather than restating the fix.

## Mutation

Each mutation is one edit to the shipped `.ets`; the test file is unchanged.

| mutation | result |
| --- | --- |
| M1 — delete the two userinfo lines | `20 / 16 / 4` |
| M2 — remove the `\` break (char code 92) | `20 / 18 / 2` |
| M3 — remove the TAB/LF/CR skip | `20 / 19 / 1` |

Restoring each edit returns `20/20`. The four M1 reds are the userinfo cases, the two M2 reds are the `\@` cases, the single M3 red is the TAB case — so every branch of the rewrite is pinned by an assertion instead of being dead code.

## Not covered here

- `deepSearchSourceTitle` at `:3855` (`text(source && source.title) || url`) still falls back to the whole URL when a source has no title. That is a citation-title decision, not the host label, and it is left for a follow-up.
- A percent-encoded `%5c` in the authority is kept in the label as-is; such a URL does not open, so the label fails closed.
- The upstream source filter at `:3850` compares the scheme case-insensitively only in this function; a `HTTPS://…` source never reaches it today because the filter above is case-sensitive.

<sub>Fledge · DigitalMate · Dev-1 · implemented</sub>

526.body:
把 #400（`pr-ready` 拆到多台 runner + 退役 UT workflow）和 #514（Windows 设备机跑 Hypium 与 ST）合成一个 PR 重新提交。

## 背景

#400 先合入后又被 main 回退（`5ffdc1aa Revert "ci: consolidate the pr-ready gate across runners and retire UT"`）。回退后 main 上的 `ci.yml` 仍然是单个 `gate` job 跑在 macOS 上，而 Hypium 与设备 ST 需要的 DevEco Studio、SDK 和模拟器其实都在 Windows 设备机上。这个 PR 把「拆分」和「Windows lane」一起提，避免再出现拆完却没有 Windows 执行者的情况。

## 门禁结构

| job | runner | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| `pr-ready-node-ut` | Linux `dm-nodeut` | node 单测 + 行覆盖率门禁 |
| `pr-ready-hypium-ut` | Windows `hypium-windows` + `harmony-device` | Hypium 单元测试 |
| `pr-ready-st` | Windows `hypium-windows` + `harmony-device` | 附件策略设备 ST |
| `pr-ready-report` | Linux `dm-utility` | 汇总前三个 part |

`ut.yml` 退役，避免同一批用例跑两遍；`claude-review.yml` 一并移除。

## Windows 侧要点

- `scripts/ci/hypium-ut.ps1`、`scripts/ci/st.ps1` 与对应的 `.sh` 保持同一契约：hvigor 在用例失败时仍返回 0，所以两个脚本都读 `test_result.txt`，要求 `Failure: 0` / `Error: 0`。
- DevEco Studio 按「显式参数 → `DEVECO_HOME` → `D:\DevEco Studio` → `D:\Tools\DevEco Studio` → Program Files」顺序探测，因为两台 Windows runner 的安装位置不同。
- 两个 job 都要求 `harmony-device` 标签：只有 `hypium-windows` 的话，没有模拟器的那台 Windows 机器会抢到 ST job 然后失败。
- 源码快照走 `api.github.com` 与 `codeload.github.com` 两个源，速度低于 20 KB/s 持续一分钟就重试，而不是耗到 job 超时。
- 解包优先用 Git 自带的 GNU tar：仓库里有中文文件名资源（如 `智能体.svg`），Windows 自带 `tar.exe` 在 ANSI 代码页下会报 `Invalid empty pathname`；同时也能绕过 .NET 解压的 MAX_PATH 限制。
- `ST_DEVICE_ID` 只作为偏好：先用 `hdc list targets` 核实该 target 在线，不在就找别的 127.0.0.1 target，再没有就启动模拟器；已有 Emulator 进程在启动中则等待而不是重复拉起。

## 验证

`workflow_dispatch --ref ci/pr-ready-windows-combined`（`pull_request_target` 用的是 main 的 workflow，所以只能这样验证）：

- `pr-ready-node-ut`：✅ `dm-cloud-nodeut-01`
- `pr-ready-hypium-ut`：✅ `digitalmate-win-st-01`，`Tests run: 2295, Failure: 0, Error: 0, Pass: 2295`
- `pr-ready-st`：✅ 同机，附件策略 5/5
- `pr-ready-report`：✅ `dm-utility`

本机复现：Hypium 2295/2295（热态约 49 s），ST `junit tests="5" failures="0"`，`node --test tests/unit/ci-gate.test.mjs tests/unit/pr-ready-report.test.mjs tests/unit/issue-workflows.test.mjs` 全绿。

## 关于 `ut.yml`

rebase 到 `9bef53ee` 时，`main` 刚好把 `ut.yml` 的 e2e 发现从逐个文件名改成了 `tests/e2e/workflow/*.test.mjs`。本 PR 仍然删除 `ut.yml`，但那个 glob 已经同步进 `scripts/ci/node-tests.sh`，而 `pr-ready-node-ut` 走的 `scripts/ci/node-ut.sh` 就是调它——同一批 e2e 用例照跑，只是换了个入口，不会漏掉新加的 e2e 测试。

## 说明

- 只提 PR，不合入。
- 原来的 #514 已关闭，内容并入本 PR。

528.author: qq56734
528.body:
## What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

## What does this PR do / why do we need it

This carries the two changes that were **not** in #516 / #517, rebased onto the current `main`. Those two PRs are merged; this branch starts from `1432414e` and touches only `cloud-adapter`.

### #291 — one classification for every failed turn

A failed turn used to be judged three times. `isModelFailure()` decided whether a result was a failure at all, `digitalmateTaskFailureText()` decided what to say about it, and the notification module imported that wording back out of the conversation model. Each knew a different subset of the shapes the cloud actually sends, so a failure whose wording was not in the table fell through to the generic 「云端任务执行失败」 line **even when the cloud had already said what happened**.

For #291 specifically: a turn that ended without a reply produced **nothing at all** when it was stopped or when the execution service died, so the transcript looked as if the question were still running.

The classification now lives in `DigitalMateStatus.ets` and the text entry point delegates to it, so the wording cannot drift from the decision again. The table is ordered and the order carries meaning the tests pin:

- `quota` outranks `auth` outranks `rate` — a provider error that also mentions a missing answer is still a provider error
- `service` (execution service died) is not a model failure: one is a restart, the other a credential fix
- the cloud's own 「这一轮结束了，但没有给出回答」 is now its own kind instead of a generic failure. It names no cause, so it gets neither a quota nor a credential story, and it is retryable because the next attempt can simply work
- `interrupted` (a user stop) is its own kind and is deliberately **not** matched by the proof that every real failure keeps the phrase the device e2e detects — a stop is not a failure, and the workflow must not record it as one

### #367 — a failure is no longer quotable

Quoting a failure back wrote it into the next turn's context, which is exactly how one failed task made the following ones fail.

The guard sits beside the role decision rather than in each renderer: the reply button in the chat is only one of the entry points, and a second shell must not have to re-derive the same rule. A stopped turn needs no separate clause — it is emitted with role `cancelled`, which is outside the quotable set. (The first version of the comment claimed stops were excluded by the `!failed` check; that was wrong, and the comment now says what the code actually does.)

### Also: three test loaders stripped only the first import

`DigitalMateConversation` gained a second import on `main`, and three tests each removed just the first one with a non-multiline `/^import.../` regex. The remaining import reached the `Function` constructor and all three failed with `Cannot use import statement outside a module`. They now pass `/gm`. This is a pre-existing breakage that surfaced as soon as the branch gained its import — worth fixing here because the tests guard the code this PR changes.

## Verification

**#367 is a negative assertion** — something that must not be produced — so no screenshot can show it. `tests/unit/digitalmate-failure-quote-guard.test.mjs` (5 tests) drives the **real conversation model** from a real snapshot and asserts:

- a normal answer **stays** quotable
- a failed turn still renders with role `error` (the user has to see what happened) while its `replyTarget` stays `undefined`
- a stop is not quotable either
- a failure never becomes a quote target merely by being the newest row
- the decision is read from one place, with no renderer re-deriving it

**Verified by removing the `!failed` clause: 3 of the 5 fail, and pass again once restored.**

For #291, `digitalmate-status.test.mjs` (10 tests) pins every shape and its wording, including that every real failure still matches the e2e `FAILURE` regex at `tests/e2e/workflow/driver.mjs:33` — if a failure message stopped matching it, a broken turn would be recorded as a completed reply.

Suites: `digitalmate-status` 10, `digitalmate-failure-quote-guard` 5, `digitalmate-message-actions` 15, plus `digitalmate-adapter`, `digitalmate-notifications`, `digitalmate-parallel-topics`, `digitalmate-topic-async` — all pass.

Full suite: **2343 pass / 2 fail**, the same 2 environment failures clean `openjiuwen/main` has (`agc-sms-server`, `sync-auth-config`). **Zero new.** `entry` HAP: **BUILD SUCCESSFUL**.

### What is not verified

**Neither change is verified on a device**, and this PR does not claim otherwise.

Disconnecting the network does **not** reach this code: the message is queued (「连接中，消息将稍后发送…」) and the banner comes from the connection layer (`DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets:20`), so the turn never becomes `failed` and the classifier never runs. Reaching it needs the network up and the cloud to actually return a failure — quota exhaustion, or the no-answer sentence. Until then this is covered by unit tests only.

Closes #291
Closes #367

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:
Owned WorkSwarm startup previously only managed permissions and search. Personal Runtime switches could therefore inherit enabled upstream/stale workspace settings, and later dotenv reloads could reopen the browser or change the native search fallback.

Centralize product-owned disabled switches in the existing launcher and apply them through WorkSwarm update_config(): setup guide, auto recap, updater, RSI, Symphony orchestration/evolution, proactive recommendations, skill evolution, TTSE, and statusline/code/research/browser subagents. Persist both browser environment gates and the resolved search fallback into the workspace and selected dotenv files before supervisor startup.

Keep model/credential/user configuration, shared general subagents, memory and Skill retrieval settings, and the deployment-controlled permission switch. Document the configuration ownership and startup order. Update an existing search policy test to explicitly enable permissions and assert preservation of its custom bash rule, matching existing production behavior.

Scope: owned runtime startup/restart only. This does not delete Team code, enforce policy against runtime config writes, change external WorkSwarm instances, implement Bot identity/prefix-cache changes, or deploy to cloud.


**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
<!-- 
*Automatically closes linked issue when PR is merged.
Usage: `Fixes #<issue number>`, or `Fixes (paste link of issue)`.
-->
None; implements the requested Personal Runtime startup policy from the 2026-11-03 design review. No issue is linked.


**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：
Base: main 1432414e63f97f6510a34b096722a05de286c1b7.
Final tested commit: 35ecacfde9791671a2c82f2d3a0c42e8898fb99d.
Environment: Windows, Python 3.12 (existing orbit-host-qa-venv).

Command (PYTHONPATH=harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src):
```sh
python -m pytest harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_workswarm_runtime_policy.py harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_search_policy.py harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_search_mcp.py -q
```
Result on the final commit: 29 passed, 7 subtests passed in 5.20s.

Covered: stale enabled settings are disabled; shared capabilities and user/model data are preserved; missing/null sections and invalid mappings; idempotence; permission deployment switch; workspace/selected dotenv reloads with override=True; search fallback selection; launcher ordering before supervisor (mocked supervisor); existing search and permission regression tests. git -c core.whitespace=cr-at-eol diff --check passed; worktree clean after commit.

Baseline comparison: two existing search-MCP expectations disagreed with the unchanged platform_policy behavior (default permissions false, custom bash:allow retained); the test now selects permissions=true explicitly and checks that custom rule is retained. No baseline performance comparison was run.

Not verified: real supervisor/AgentServer startup, actual registered agent/tool schemas, live model calls, cloud deployment, phone/device, HarmonyOS/image builds, performance/reliability, or the full Python/Node suites. No UI/platform code is changed. CI results are pending and are not claimed as passing. Running native config writes can still change YAML until the next startup reapplies policy.

531.author: qq56734
531.body:
## What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

## What does this PR do / why do we need it

A failed turn was judged **three times**. `isModelFailure()` decided whether a result text was a provider error at all, `digitalmateTaskFailureText()` decided what to say about it, and the notification module imported that wording back out of the conversation model. Each knew a different subset of the shapes the cloud actually sends, so a failure whose wording was not in the table fell through to the generic 「云端任务执行失败」 line **even when the cloud had already said what happened**.

The classification now lives in one ordered table (`DigitalMateStatus.ets`) and the text entry point delegates to it. Order carries meaning, and the tests pin it — `quota` outranks `auth` outranks `rate`, because a provider error that also mentions a missing answer is still a provider error.

### `serviceInterruption()` no longer holds its own copy

It was a **verbatim duplicate** of the rule in the table — the very drift this module exists to remove. The two copies differed, too: only the predicate anchored at the start. The predicate now delegates, and the rule kept the anchor, so behaviour is unchanged for every shape the runtime emits. A test asserts the literal pattern does not appear twice.

### Two shapes were not representable before this change

- **The cloud's own 「这一轮结束了，但没有给出回答」** had no entry, so a turn that ended without producing anything was reported as a generic execution failure. It is now its own kind: it names no cause, so it gets neither a quota nor a credential story.
- **An execution-service failure** (`Jiuwen Swarm is not running at ...`) was reported as a model failure. The remedies differ — one is a restart, the other a credential fix — so it is now separate.

`isModelFailure()` stays deliberately **stricter** than the table. An answer that merely discusses `AuthenticationError` or `quota` is still an answer, so it only matches the anchored shapes the runtime itself emits.

### Two things deliberately NOT added (both caught reviewing an earlier draft)

- **An `interrupted` kind.** A user stop is a task *status* (`cancelled`), not a result string, and `digitalmateTerminalReplyText()` already renders it without consulting this table. The rule could only match a literal result text of `"cancelled"`, which no caller produces — it looked like coverage while every real stop bypassed it. A test now pins that those strings classify as `unknown`.
- **A per-cause `retryable()`.** It answered the same question as `digitalmateTaskRetryable()`, in the **opposite direction**: this one would call a quota failure non-retryable while the task predicate calls every failed task retryable. The retry button reads the task predicate, so a second answer would only invite drift. A test asserts the contradictory one is neither exported nor defined.

### Scope note

A turn that ends without a reply **already** produced a closing status row before this change — that block is on `main` at `DigitalMateConversation.ets:517-536`. **This PR does not add that behaviour.** It corrects *which message* the row carries. The earlier combined PR (#528, closed) claimed that behaviour as new; that was wrong, and this description replaces it.

### Test loaders

Five tests load `DigitalMateConversation` by stripping its imports, so once the model gained an import for failure wording they failed with `digitalmateStatusKind is not defined`. Each now injects a stub (three also needed `/gm` so a second import is not left behind).

## Verification

Two later findings are also fixed here, both reproduced on this branch first:

- **F16** — `_answer_after_stop()` appends `已读取的页面：` and then each URL plus a 200-character excerpt of the page's own text. That is site content, not a diagnostic, and classifying it let a docs page mentioning `AuthenticationError` tell the user their credentials had expired. `classifyText()` now truncates the page block before any rule runs.
- **F17** — the catch-all family (`请求的步骤没有返回可用结果…`) had no rule, so the header decided and the product said 请稍后重试一次, discarding the cloud's "review any completed work before trying again". It now maps to `unknown`, with its rule above `no_answer` so it wins the combined string.


### On a real device: 30/30 PASS

![失败分类真机诊断](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/b4e48332/docs/developer_guide/validation/issue-291-367-status-20261104/02-failure-classification-device-part1.jpeg?raw=true)

![失败分类真机诊断（续）](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/b4e48332/docs/developer_guide/validation/issue-291-367-status-20261104/03-failure-classification-device-part2.jpeg?raw=true)

Device `77TYD26810020780` (JDY-AL50, HarmonyOS 7.0.0.109(SP6C), API 26). This renders the output of the **shipped** `digitalmateStatusKind()` / `digitalmateStatusText()`, compiled into the device build, for the exact strings the cloud sends — including the no-answer sentence that used to fall through to the generic failure, and `cancelled` classifying as `unknown` (proof the unreachable `interrupted` rule is gone).

**What this proves:** the classification and its wording work in a device build.
**What it does not prove:** that the cloud sends these strings (evidence: `digitalmate-adapter.test.mjs` and the runtime's own error format), or how the transcript renders the line.

**Why it is not a screenshot of a failed turn in the chat:** disconnecting the network does not reach this code. The message is queued (「连接中，消息将稍后发送…」), the banner comes from the connection layer (`DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets:19-20`), and the task stays `waiting` — so the classifier never runs. A mock cloud was attempted and rejected: `loadDigitalMateGatewayConfig()` requires `wss:` on both sides with matching hostnames, and the device rejects self-signed certificates, so reaching it would have meant bypassing three security checks and forging a credential — weaker evidence than the unit tests. Full reasoning in `docs/developer_guide/validation/issue-291-367-status-20261104/README.md`. All temporary probe code was reverted; the branch contains none of it.

### Unit tests

`digitalmate-status.test.mjs` — **36 pass** (measured at `d58be588`). Each review finding below has its own test, so a regression is a failure rather than a re-review. One of them does not copy the bridge's wording at all: it enumerates the 14 families × 3 languages straight out of `server.py` at test time, so a family added upstream fails the suite and names its sentences.

- Full suite: **2506 pass / 4 fail** (measured at `d58be588`, after rebasing onto `8a5f9050`). All four fail on clean `openjiuwen/main` too: `agc-sms-server`, `sync-auth-config`, `ascf-device/build-boundary.test.mjs`'s "private Web HAR selection", and `st-live-wire-chunks.test.mjs` (that one cannot resolve the `ws` module in this container). **Zero new.**
- `entry` HAP: **BUILD SUCCESSFUL**

## Review findings, and what each one changed

All of them were the same shape: **the table was introduced, but something beside it still decided the same thing.** That is the drift this PR exists to remove, so each is fixed at the decision, not at the symptom.

The first group is the table's own coverage; the second is the evidence around it, which is where the later rounds landed.

| # | Finding | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| **F1** | `service` wording reached the activity summary and the reminder but **not the chat row**, because `serviceInterruption()` short-circuited the `failed` branch that delegates to the table. One interruption had **three sentences**. | A failed row now takes the table's sentence; only a non-failed row keeps the short cause-only line. `digitalmateTerminalReplyText()` delegates too instead of keeping a fourth. |
| **F3** | The table only knew **Chinese** sentences. The bridge picks wording by the assignment's language, so every English and French failure fell through to the generic line. | Rules now cover what `_answer_after_stop()`, `model_failure_note()` and `_user_failure_lines()` actually emit — including the **model-service and tool/site failures**, the most common family in practice and previously all `unknown`. |
| **F4** | `unknown` said 云端任务执行失败 without saying the cause was unknown, so a user could not tell an **unclassified** failure from a classified one. | States the gap, keeps the e2e phrase, still guesses nothing. |
| **F6** | The `service` rule carried an arbitrary exception suffix, so a **later** rule the suffix mentioned won: `swarm socket failed: upstream connect error timed out` → `timeout`. A waiting task with a stolen kind **lost its closing row and retry button**. | `service` now runs first, anchored, matching the whole diagnostic. |
| **F7** | The validation note cited a test file that lives in **#532**, not here. | Corrected, and a test asserts every `.test.mjs` the note cites exists in this branch. |
| **F8–F13** | Two exception classes `isModelFailure()` named (`APIError`, `APIConnectionError`) had no rule, so a real provider failure landed on the generic line. Found by a **device probe** that scored 19/20, not by review. | Both added; the list is now asserted against the class names the guard itself matches. |
| **F14** | `_answer_after_stop()` concatenates the no-answer header with a cause sentence into **one string**, and `no_answer` outranked every cause rule — so 7 of 12 families lost the cloud's remedy, `unconfirmed` most dangerously ("check whether the change already applied" became "retry once"). | Cause rules run before `no_answer`; each family has a test built from the combined shape. |
| **F16 / F19** | The same function appends a **page block** (URL + 200 characters of the page's own text). A docs page mentioning `AuthenticationError` made a plain no-answer report expired credentials. My first fix missed three of the five header spellings, and the French ones I wrote **from memory** were `exploitable` where the source says `utilisable` — a rule that could never match, which is why it reopened twice. | `classifyText()` truncates the block; all five headers plus their empty variants are pinned, and the strings are read from `server.py` rather than recalled. |
| **F17 / F20** | The catch-all family had no rule, so it became a no-answer and invited an immediate retry. Then the *wording* kept the hazard even once the kind was right. | Its own rule above `no_answer`; the `unknown` sentence now says 先检查已完成的工作，再决定是否重试, in that order, with a test on the order. |
| **F21** | The guard this PR adds to stop the table drifting from the bridge **had the same defect**: the slice started at `"request": (` without its indentation, so that family was silently outside the guard while `>= 13` still passed. | Slice anchored at the indentation, count pinned at `=== 14`, `request` asserted by name. Reverse-verified: the old slice reports 13 and names what is missing. |
| **F24** | `model` sat above `unconfirmed`, so a turn that failed on the model *and* left a write unconfirmed reported "check the model connection and retry" - dropping the cloud's check-first instruction, the duplicate-write hazard F14/F17/F20 exist to prevent. | `unconfirmed` now sits above `model`: its remedy is compatible with any other cause, so it may outrank them; the reverse is not true. A test pins both the classification and the order in the source. |
| **F25** | The F21 guard was a window between two family names, so a family added at the top or appended after `unknown` kept the count at 14 and the suite green. | Scan covers the whole function body, from `def _user_failure_lines(` to the dict's closing brace. Verified at all three insertion points. |
| **F18 / F22 / F23** | The evidence around the code drifted: this description quoted counts from an older head, and the committed record kept one row showing an output the shipped function cannot produce. | Counts re-measured at `d58be588` and stated with their commit; the record's row corrected. F22 (the gate could not find `scripts/ci/node-ut.sh` because the branch predated it) is fixed by rebasing onto `8a5f9050`. |

Reverse-verified throughout: moving the `service` rule back to the end fails exactly the service-family test; restoring the page-block guard gap fails exactly the truncation test; restoring the old slice start fails the family guard and names the missing family.

**F2 and F5 were already fixed** in the previous round (the unreachable `interrupted` kind removed, the five import-stripping loaders given a stub). Re-checked here rather than taken on trust.

Closes #291

532.author: qq56734
532.body:
## What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

## What does this PR do / why do we need it

Quoting a failure wrote it into the next turn's context, which is exactly how **one failed task made the following ones fail**.

The guard sits beside the role decision rather than in each renderer. The reply button in the chat is only one of the entry points, and a second shell must not have to re-derive the same rule: a renderer-local check would drift, and the drift would only show up as a mysterious second failure.

```diff
+ const quotable = !failed && ['message', 'result', 'remark', 'question'].includes(message.kind);
  ...
- replyTarget: ['message', 'result', 'remark', 'question'].includes(message.kind) ? ...
+ replyTarget: quotable ? ...
```

The failure row itself **still renders**, with role `error`. The only change is that the user cannot attach it to their next message — they still need to see what happened.

## Verification

I first wrote here that `**no screenshot can show it**` because the difference is a field absent from a data model. **That was wrong**, and it was the kind of claim that stops a reviewer from checking anything: the quote button is conditionally rendered, so its absence *is* visible. Two device screenshots now show it.

![a normal answer has a quote button](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/9dc534bc/docs/developer_guide/validation/issue-367-failure-not-quotable/01-normal-answer-has-quote.jpeg?raw=true)

![a rewritten notice has only copy](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/9dc534bc/docs/developer_guide/validation/issue-367-failure-not-quotable/02-rewritten-notice-has-no-quote.jpeg?raw=true)

The contrast is inside one conversation on a real device (JDY-AL50, HarmonyOS 7.0.0.109, API 26, real cloud):

| row | buttons |
|---|---|
| a normal answer | **copy + quote** |
| a user stop | none (a stop is not an answer) |
| a rewritten environment diagnostic | **copy only** |

The third row is the one this PR is about. The request asked the model to repeat a diagnostic verbatim; the bubble showed the rewritten notice instead, and its quote button is gone. Reproduced locally to prove the sentence really came from the diagnostic and not from the model:

```
digitalmateEnvironmentDiagnostic('openjiuwen 运行时未安装，请先在终端运行 pip install openjiuwen 后再继续') = true
digitalmateUserVisibleText(same) === digitalmateCapabilityUnavailable() = true
```

That row matters because its stored text contains an `pip install` instruction: quoting it would write that instruction into the next turn's context, which is exactly the class of write-back this PR removes.

`tests/unit/digitalmate-failure-quote-guard.test.mjs` (**10 pass**) drives the **real conversation model** from a real snapshot shape rather than grepping for the expression:

| assertion | why |
|---|---|
| an ordinary answer **stays** quotable | the guard must not break normal quoting |
| a failed turn renders with `role: 'error'` while `replyTarget` is `undefined` | the user sees the failure but cannot quote it |
| a **service-interruption** notice is not quotable | finding F1 below |
| a **no-answer** notice is not quotable | finding F1 below |
| a **capability notice** is not quotable | finding F2 below |
| the environment diagnostic under test really is one | otherwise the case above would pass on a string that was never a diagnostic |
| why the capability notice must not be quotable — demonstrated | a user row quoting it renders the raw `pip install` text |
| a stop is not quotable — **by a different mechanism** | see below |
| a failure never becomes quotable merely by being the newest row | the reply UI picks the row the user taps |
| the decision is read from one place | no renderer re-derives its own rule |

**Verified by removing the `!failed` clause: exactly 3 fail, and pass again once it is restored. Removing `!capability`: exactly 2 fail.**

### Finding F1: the guard was keyed on one branch

The first version tested **"this row says 失败"**, but two other rows are rewritten by the same block and were left quotable:

- a **service-interruption** notice — its text is replaced *because* the task never reached `failed`, so `!failed` was true for it;
- a **no-answer** notice — same shape.

Both are turn-end notices, not answers, so quoting either writes a diagnostic or an apology into the next turn's context: **the exact failure mode #367 exists to prevent**. The predicate is now *"this row is not an answer"*, which is what the original was really after.

The decision is taken **once per row** and reused for both the text and the quote target, so a notice cannot be rewritten without also losing its reply button.

Reverse-verified: dropping the two new clauses fails exactly the three source-level notices above.

### A miscoding I fixed after review

An earlier revision of this branch claimed a stopped turn was excluded because `role: 'cancelled'` sits outside the quotable set. **That was wrong, and the test written for it was vacuous**: a stopped turn is a *task status*, emitted by a separate push further down that has **no `replyTarget` key at all** — so the test passed with or without the `!failed` clause, and the reverse verification showed only 3 failures instead of 4.

A stop is still unquotable — the outcome was right — but the *reason* was not the quotable set. Both the code comment and the test now state the real mechanism, and the test additionally asserts that the cancelled push carries no `replyTarget`, so it fails if that push ever gains one. Verified: adding `replyTarget` to that push now fails the test.

- Full suite: **2480 pass / 4 fail** (measured at `9dc534bc`, after rebasing onto `8a5f9050`). All four fail on clean `openjiuwen/main` too: `agc-sms-server`, `sync-auth-config`, `ascf-device/build-boundary.test.mjs`'s "private Web HAR selection", and `st-live-wire-chunks.test.mjs` (that one cannot resolve the `ws` module in this container). **Zero new.**
- `entry` HAP: **BUILD SUCCESSFUL**

### What is not verified on a device

Three rows are still only covered by tests: a `failed` turn, a service-interruption notice and a no-answer notice. Each needs the cloud to actually fail, and I could not produce that on this device:

- disconnecting the network does not reach the failure path — the composer shows 网络不可用 and the message is never sent, so no failure row exists;
- asking the model to call a tool that does not exist still produces a normal answer (the task succeeds; only the command inside it fails), which is why that row keeps its quote button.

I am not claiming device coverage for those three. The screenshots cover the two shapes I could produce, and the test file covers the rest.

## Relationship to #291

Split out of #528 so the two concerns review separately. This branch reads the failure wording through whatever `DigitalMateConversation` provides; the test stubs it, so this PR is independent of #531 and the two can merge in either order (verified: a test merge of the two branches has no conflicts).

Closes #367

536.author: haowenz001
536.body:
## What

Every self-hosted gate job now resolves `runs-on` from a `RUNNER_*` repository variable, keeping the current labels as a literal fallback:

```yaml
runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.RUNNER_CI_NODE_UT || '["self-hosted","Linux","X64","dm-nodeut"]') }}
```

Changing which machine runs a job no longer needs a workflow edit or a pull request. Setting the variable applies to the next workflow run; jobs already running keep their assigned runner.

This branch now includes `main` after #526 consolidated `ut.yml` into `ci.yml`; the routing catalog follows the new `node-ut` / `hypium-ut` / `st` / `gate-report` jobs.

## Changes

- `.github/ci-runners.json`: job → variable → default-label catalog for all 15 self-hosted jobs.
- `scripts/ci-runners.mjs`: `list`, `set`, `reset`, `apply`; supports dry-run, comma lists, JSON arrays and runner groups.
- Converted `ci.yml` (`node-ut`, `hypium-ut`, `st`, `gate-report`), `code-check.yml`, `server-regression.yml`, `eval.yml`, `nightly.yml` and `bench.yml`. GitHub-hosted jobs are unchanged.
- `tests/unit/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs`: keeps each workflow fallback in sync with the catalog, and covers the CLI against a mock Actions variables API.
- `docs/developer_guide/ci.md`: usage, caveats and the full variable table.
- **Also:** `Eval contract (replay)` no longer runs on pull requests. The replay fixtures validate the eval harness, not the product, and its `actions/checkout` step repeatedly timed out on the self-hosted runner. It remains available on pushes to main (eval paths) and `workflow_dispatch`. Covered by a unit test so the PR trigger does not come back.

## Usage

```bash
node scripts/ci-runners.mjs list
node scripts/ci-runners.mjs set ci_node_ut self-hosted,Linux,X64,dm-utility
node scripts/ci-runners.mjs apply /tmp/runner-routing.json
node scripts/ci-runners.mjs reset --all
```

## Behavior and caveats

- With no variables set, behavior is unchanged: every default is the label set that was hard-coded before.
- Changing a default still needs a PR; switching machines does not.
- `pull_request_target` workflows execute the default branch's workflow file, so the runner-routing mechanism becomes effective on PRs once this merges.
- The target runner must already carry the configured labels (or belong to the named runner group).
- Changing variables needs repository admin; `--dry-run` previews the plan.

## Verification

- `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs tests/unit/ascf-device/*.test.mjs tests/e2e/workflow/workflow.test.mjs`: 2526 tests, 2524 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed (after merging main).
- `actionlint` on the changed workflows: no new findings (only pre-existing shellcheck warnings).
- YAML parse check on all workflow files and `.github/ci-runners.json`.
536.head: feat/configurable-runner-routing
536.title: feat(ci): make gate runner assignment configurable
