547.author: qq56734
547.body:
## What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

## What does this PR do / why do we need it

A reply containing an SVG document showed **<svg ...> markup in the bubble**, and the xmlns URL even became a tappable link.

The parser had no concept of a picture. A bare document fell through to an ordinary paragraph, so markup reached the text renderer. Only a  `mermaid  fence had a drawing path at all.

### The parser recognises one closed document as its own block

Three shapes reach it, because models emit the same picture all three ways: a **bare document in the prose**, a **```svg fence**, and an **unlabelled, ```xml or ```svg+xml fence**. Labelling it svg says nothing about whether the document is complete, so the label is not the decision - but it is a **veto**: ```html, ```js and ```ts mean the user asked for the *source*, and `SvgBlock` only reveals the source when rendering fails, which a valid document never does. Turning that fence into a picture would answer "give me the HTML to embed this chart" with an image and nothing to copy.

That is why **a labelled fence still has to close**. A truncated document stays code, where the user can read it, rather than becoming a renderer call that can only fail.

Two guards keep this from swallowing prose:
- text that merely **mentions** the tag stays text;
- an **unterminated** document stays text, so a streaming reply does not flicker into a half-drawn picture.

### A paragraph that only describes the tag is not a picture

"Starts at `<svg` and ends at `</svg>`" was not enough. A sentence that *describes* the tag satisfies both: `<svg> 是矢量图标签。\n这段是说明。\n</svg> 是结束标签。` is well-formed XML whose root is `svg` and whose content is text — so it parsed, went to the renderer, and the explanation became a **blank picture** instead of the sentence the user could have read.

A drawn document has either attributes on the root (every generator emits `xmlns` at least) or child elements. Text directly inside a bare `<svg>` with neither is a mention. A blank picture carries no information either way, so treating it as prose costs nothing — which is why the check is "attributes **or** child elements" rather than a stricter rule that would start rejecting real drawings.

### The document has to start its own line

A bare document is detected while walking the prose, and an earlier version would happily find a `<svg` in the middle of a line and then skip every line between it and the document — swallowing the prose that led up to it. A bare document now has to begin its line.

### Rendering reuses the diagram pipeline

Both are a WebView snapshot, so there is no second pipeline to drift. `CloudMarkdownView` gained an `SvgBlock` with the same lifecycle as `MermaidBlock` — wait while streaming, fall back to the source **only on failure** — and `renderDiagram` now draws a raw SVG document directly instead of handing it to mermaid (which would only fail on it).

One bug I hit while wiring it: the block key did not include the renderer version for picture blocks, so a **finished picture would never replace the loading placeholder**. Fixed and covered.

## Verification

### On a real device, against the live cloud — with a before/after pair

Unlike #291, this needs no constructed failure: an SVG is an ordinary output shape. **The same request** was sent to the real cloud from both builds:

`
draw an svg bar chart with four bars labeled Jan Feb Mar Apr with heights 30 45 60 25, output raw svg only
`

| before | after |
|---|---|
| ![源码贴进气泡](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/undefined/docs/developer_guide/validation/issue-458-svg-device-20261104/01-before-source-in-bubble.jpeg?raw=true) | ![渲染为图](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/undefined/docs/developer_guide/validation/issue-458-svg-device-20261104/02-after-rendered.jpeg?raw=true) |

**Same cloud output, only the client differs** — so this is an A/B pair, not two different requests that happened to differ. The "before" build is clean `openjiuwen/main` at `9bef53ee` — no part of this branch applied. That is the comparison the record documents, and it is what the reader needs: the "after" build has the whole change, so the pair shows the defect and its fix rather than isolating one file. (An earlier version of this description claimed the "before" shot came from stashing only the parser change; that was not how the image was produced, and it contradicted the record.)

The "after" shot also confirms the renderer's direct branch worked: had the SVG gone to mermaid, it would have errored and fallen back to source.

### Unit tests

`tests/unit/cloud-markdown-svg.test.mjs` — **28 pass**, covering all three shapes, both prose guards, the truncated-fence case, structure preservation between other blocks, two documents in one reply, prologs and leading comments, nested `<svg>`, and the mention-versus-drawing decision.

`tests/unit/mermaid-render-svg-sanitize.test.mjs` — **6 pass** on the renderer's sanitiser.

Together **34 pass**, matching `node --test <the two files>`.

Reverse-verified at the current head (measured at `ca79075c`, each injected and then restored):

| logic removed | tests that failed |
|---|---|
| the bare-document branch | **11** (#1 #2 #10 #12 #16 #17 #18 #20 #24 #27 #28) |
| the fence decision (back to always-code) | **11** (#3 #4 #5 #13 #20 #21 #22 #23 #24 #25 #27) |
| prolog / leading-comment stripping | **2** (#11 #21) |
| the bare document must start its own line (F7) | **1** |
| the attribute-or-child-element check, whole (F12) | **1** |
| only the attribute check, dropping the child check (F12) | **1** |
| the fence language whitelist (F15) | **1** (#23) |
| skipping self-closing tags in the depth scan (F16) | **1** (#24) |
| the label veto in the streaming fallback (F17) | **1** (#25) |
| `svg` on the skill-preview renderer's code branch (F18) | **1** (#26) |
| a DOCTYPE in the leading-prolog strip (F20) | **1** (#27) |
| a `</svg>` inside a comment or CDATA (F22) | **1** (#28) |
| the sanitiser keeping `data:image/` (F21) | **1** (sanitise file, #6) |

The first two rows used to read 4 and 3: those were the counts when this file had 12 tests, and they were left behind when the file grew to 24. Re-measured rather than adjusted, because the second number in particular had no relation to a line of the current suite.

- Full suite: **2557 pass / 4 fail** (measured at `ca79075c`; measured on a clean checkout of `openjiuwen/main` in a separate worktree, the same command gives **2523 pass / 4 fail** - a delta of 34, exactly the two test files added here (28 + 6)). All four fail on clean `openjiuwen/main` too: `agc-sms-server`, `sync-auth-config`, `ascf-device/build-boundary.test.mjs`'s "private Web HAR selection", and `st-live-wire-chunks.test.mjs` (that one cannot resolve the `ws` module in this container). **Zero new.**
- `entry` HAP: **BUILD SUCCESSFUL**

### What this does not cover

- The `svg`, unlabelled, and `xml` fences were **not** exercised on a device — they are equivalent at the parse layer and covered by the unit tests; the device run proves one of the three reaches the shared render entry.
- The **render-failure fallback** was not exercised: that needs an SVG Chrome cannot draw.
- Layout with several pictures in one long reply was not measured separately.

Details in `docs/developer_guide/validation/issue-458-svg-device-20261104/README.md`.

Closes #458

549.body:
**What type of PR is this?**

/kind task

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

Replace REST tarball downloads in Code Check with shallow Git fetches for the Hong Kong self-hosted runners.

- Fetch base and head commits into one temporary Git repository to reuse shared objects.
- Fetch only once when base and head point to the same commit, then export separate `trusted` and `pr-head` source trees.
- Verify fetched commit SHAs and apply bounded retries and timeouts.
- Continue using the base commit’s trusted lint configuration and report parser.
- Use the preinstalled CodeLinter toolchain and verify its log directory is writable.
- Update CI contract tests for the new Code Check fetch behavior while retaining API-based source downloads for Node UT.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Tracked by #920.

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：

- All 15 tests in `ci-gate.test.mjs` and `codelinter-report.test.mjs` passed locally.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- The Git-fetch workflow passed an actual Code Check run in the personal fork on the Hong Kong runner using Command Line Tools 6.1.0.860.
- Scanning identical source with identical rules produced zero errors with toolchain 6.1.0.860 and 58 `await-thenable` errors with toolchain 26.0.0.865. The deployment therefore retains the verified 6.1 toolchain.
- Upstream PR execution and concurrent execution on both new runners remain to be validated after the rollout.

**Self-checklist**:

- [ ] **Design**: Pending Maintainer review.
- [ ] **Test**: Relevant unit tests passed. Upstream rollout and concurrency verification remain pending.
- [x] **Verification**: Verification results and outstanding validation are described above.
- [ ] **Interface**: No external business API changes.
- [ ] **Document**: No official website documentation changes.

**Special notes for your reviewers**:

Coordinate the merge with runner migration. The workflow retains the `dm-codecheck` label, which will be assigned to `dm-hk-ci-01` and `dm-hk-ci-02`.

Remove this label from the Beijing upstream runners, including the flex runner, during the cutover because Git fetch previously encountered timeouts and TLS failures there.

The existing repository CI guide still describes REST-based source downloads and should be updated to reflect this change.

551.author: HugoXK
551.body:
## 做了什么

会话抽屉里的三个纯图标可点目标此前没有任何可读名（`SessionDrawer.ets` 整文件 `grep -c accessibility` = 0），读屏只念角色，而这三个控件分别是「进设置的唯一入口」「退出搜索页的唯一手段」「输入后唯一的清空手段」。本 PR 只加可读名，不改布局、交互与任何视觉样式：

- 账号栏齿轮 `Image(ic_session_settings)`：`.accessibilityText('设置')`
- 搜索页返回 `Stack{ Image(icon_back) }`：`.accessibilityText('返回')`，内部装饰图标 `.accessibilityLevel('no')`（避免一次聚焦读两遍）
- 搜索框清空 `Image(ic_session_clear)`：`.accessibilityText('清空搜索内容')`

加名后该文件的 unnamed tap target 由 **7 → 4**，`tests/unit/a11y-baseline.json` 的对应条目同步缩小（7→4，只手工改这一行，未用 `--update` 整体重写，其余 27 条零变动）。

## Reachability（release 路径，不是 preview）

- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:2529` — `build()` 内 `if (this.drawerOpen && !this.contentOnly) { SessionDrawerView({...}) }`（该文件被 open PR #434 占用，本 PR 只引用、不修改）
- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:9412` — `if (this.accountSessionStatus === AccountSessionStatus.AUTHENTICATED) { ... SessionDrawerView({...}) }`

两个挂载点都是主页面，抽屉由首页按钮打开，没有 debug 闸门或build 变量开关。

## 证据

**红（pristine `9bef53ee`，把本 PR 的测试文件放进干净克隆后跑）**

```
$ node --test tests/unit/session-drawer-a11y.test.mjs
✖ the account-bar settings gear is named for screen readers
  AssertionError: ... must name itself with .accessibilityText(...) on its own modifier chain;
  chain starts with: "Image($r('app.media.ic_session_settings')).id('digitalmate-settings-entry')"
✖ the full-page search back control is named for screen readers
✖ the search-clear button is named for screen readers
✖ the three icon targets do not share one generic label
✔ the drawer is mounted from both release home screens
ℹ tests 5 · pass 1 · fail 4
```

**绿（本 PR head）**

```
$ node --test tests/unit/session-drawer-a11y.test.mjs
ℹ tests 5 · pass 5 · fail 0

$ node scripts/check-a11y.mjs
Files with unnamed tap targets: 28 known, 0 new or worse, 0 stale.   (exit 0)

$ node --test tests/unit/a11y-gate.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-task-card-a11y.test.mjs
ℹ tests 27 · pass 27 · fail 0
```

**变异检查（证明测试载重）**：把实现回退成 main 的三段（去掉 3 个 `accessibilityText` 与 1 个 `accessibilityLevel`）后，同一套测试 4 条断言变红；还原后再次 5/5 绿，`git diff --stat` 仍为 `4 insertions`。命令与输出见 commit `ea8bfa1` 的说明与 Dev-1 的回执。

## 风险与回滚

- 风险：low。只加无障碍属性与一行基线数字，无逻辑分支、无网络/存储/权限改动。
- 回滚：`git revert 1c2ef67`（或整分支关闭），不涉及数据迁移。
- 未覆盖：沙箱无真机，读屏实际播报内容未在设备上录制；按 `accessibilityText` 的既有用法推断（同仓 `account/AccountLoginPage.ets:159`、`files/DigitalMateAttachmentCard.ets:37`），需要在真机上补一次 TalkBack/VoiceOver 核对。

Fixes #550

<sub>Fledge · DigitalMate · Dev-1 · implemented</sub>

补充 **1 条 ST 测试用例：ART-01，产物回执异常与文件恢复**。同一源码 `a646a8d` 在 HarmonyOS 6.1/API 23 模拟器及指定真实云端完整执行两轮，**2/2 通过**。

每轮验证以下内容：

- 正常创建、下载并回读带唯一标记的 TXT。
- 当前任务正文完成但缺少产物回执时，产物列表和文件服务无可用文件。
- 当前产物 ID 无效时，实际云端拒绝读取，Native 不返回成功预览或租约。
- 当前真实下载内容被截短时，Native 返回 `INCOMPLETE_DOWNLOAD`，不返回成功预览或租约。
- 普通文本恢复后重新同步原始回执，回读四个原文件，核对内容与四条唯一文件记录。

实时转发只控制本轮拥有的产物字段和下载内容。主连接与生产文件读取 Socket 的整帧及内容哈希逐项配对；独立直连原云端核对五个任务、五条用户输入和四个原文件。

554.body:
## Summary

The current user message is already present in the conversation, but eternal-conversation prefetch also copies the full query into the system memory projection, including when no memories match. Omit only that model-facing duplicate while retaining the original retrieval query, durable audit, matches, snapshots, conflict rules and publication boundaries.

Each model evidence envelope also records the current canonical prompt-template hashes, including failed attempts and reopened legacy sessions. Existing session source manifests and historical evidence remain unchanged; no prompt versions are guessed or backfilled. This preserves creation provenance while making post-upgrade model attempts auditable.

Also shorten the repeated UI-only `call_goal` description. Keep the field optional, preserve the conversation-language and business-field constraints, and leave schema injection and pre-execution argument stripping unchanged. All existing direct tools and their execution/permission contracts remain available.

The two input reductions are separate commits; a follow-up adds per-attempt prompt-version evidence. WorkSwarm import overrides and tree identity are recorded without changing the original upstream manifests; agent-core and unrelated benchmark/helper fixes are unchanged.

## Validation

- Pinned-dependency isolated harness regression with `WORKSWARM_RUNTIME_TESTS=1`: **27 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped**. Exercises actual memory Rails/audit, reopened legacy-session and failed-attempt provenance, revision updates, context boundaries, 24-tool model-schema copying and UI argument stripping into an unchanged business function. Real HTTP is disabled.
- `python -B harness/verify_sources.py`: **2,570 WorkSwarm + 2,894 agent-core files verified**; staged WorkSwarm Git tree matches `imported_git_tree`.
- `node --test tests/unit/st-live-wire*.test.mjs`: **42 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped** (isolated checkout with the existing `ws` dependency).
- `git diff --check`: passed.

### Rebase onto current `main`

Replayed onto `e71a0259c97488d2c0224a261d4c4c2efc002460`:

| Commit | Subject |
|---|---|
| `10090350` | perf(workswarm): omit duplicate query from memory prompts |
| `310eaf32` | perf(workswarm): compact repeated call goal guidance |
| `077a197e` | fix(workswarm): record prompt versions on model evidence |
| `684ea282` | test(workswarm): align memory prefix test with query omission |
| `5cabb2e5` | build(harness): derive UPSTREAM.json identities with a checked tool |

This round needed exactly one resolution: the `harness/UPSTREAM.json` derived-identifier block. The tooling committed in `5cabb2e5` handled it — take upstream's version, re-apply this branch's overrides, recompute the identifiers — with no manual editing and no conflict markers in any commit.

### Merging with upstream's attachment refactor

Upstream `68bc5879` ("append dynamic context after the stable prefix") landed while this PR was open, and it reworked the same three files. It is not a mechanical conflict; the two changes compose:

- `render_memory_projection()` is now a thin combined view over the new `render_memory_attachments()`, which returns independent canonical sections. Upstream also switched to compact, key-sorted JSON and now feeds memory through prompt attachments.
- This PR therefore applies its query omission inside `render_memory_attachments()` — the single function that produces every projection section — instead of in one caller. Both the combined view and the attachment path inherit it, and the omission cannot drift out of sync with the refactor.
- `rail.py` keeps upstream's attachment flow and adds only the prompt-version record on the model-evidence envelope.
- The prefetch projection still normalises to `{"matches": []}` when there is no memory, so the existing contract holds.

One real regression surfaced while merging and is fixed in `b2c12659`: normalising with `dict(value or {})` dropped the empty `matches` key. It now seeds `{"matches": []}` and re-applies it, so `None`, `{}` and `{"matches": []}` all project the same shape.

Conflict resolution notes (still current):

- Upstream's `test_memory_prompt_prefix.py` asserts compact JSON and expects `"query"` in the projection. `536b906e` keeps the compact form and changes that one expectation into an explicit assertion that the duplicated query is absent; every other field must still sit after the stable prefix, and the conflict protocol, action gate and v1/0.4 wording are still asserted.
- `harness/UPSTREAM.json` takes upstream's structure wholesale (including its newer `__init__.py` and `send_file_to_user.py` overrides) and adds only this PR's entries.

Final diff against `main`: 9 files, +581/−18.

### Why `harness/UPSTREAM.json` conflicted every time

`imported_git_tree` and every `import_overrides[*].git_blob` restate bytes that already exist in the tree. Any upstream edit to a customized file rewrites exactly the lines this branch rewrites, so a branch customizing that same file conflicted on those lines on every rebase — there was no real disagreement to negotiate.

Resolving it by hand is what produced CRLF churn, trailing whitespace and duplicated prose in earlier revisions of this branch. Three things now prevent that:

- `harness/update_upstream_ids.py` recomputes both derived fields from file bytes with the verifier's own pure-Python Git object rules, needs no index or checkout state, writes the file byte-exactly, and refuses to write when a field cannot be computed. `--check` reports stale values without writing.
- `harness/tests/test_upstream_ids.py` pins that stored identifiers equal the working tree and that the file stays byte-stable under its own serialiser (LF, no BOM, no trailing whitespace, trailing newline).
- Conflicts take upstream's version from the index stage rather than from the marked-up file, then re-apply only this branch's overrides.

This was rehearsed against a synthetic upstream edit to `prompts.py`: three conflicts resolved with no manual editing, then `update_upstream_ids.py` brought the identifiers current and the verifier passed.

Verification on head `5cabb2e5`:

- `python -B harness/verify_sources.py`: **passed**; WorkSwarm tree `7cf307bb...`, agent-core tree `45b51b70...`.
- `python -B harness/update_upstream_ids.py --check`: **current**, no stale derived fields.
- `harness/tests` discovery: **76 run, 35 skipped, 6 errors**. All six are `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pydantic'`; unmodified `main` `e71a0259` reports the same six.
- `test_prompt_compaction.py` (19), `test_upstream_ids.py` (4), `test_verify_sources.py` (10): **all passing**. `test_memory_prompt_prefix.py` runs 6 with the same one `pydantic` error as `main`; its five runnable tests pass.
- `git diff --check`: passed. No conflict markers in any commit on the branch.
- The Node `st-live-wire` suite cannot run here (`node_modules` absent); this PR touches no Node sources.

### CI on the previous head

On `b2c12659` the full gate passed: `ArkTS Code Check`, `server-regression`, `node-ut`, `hypium-ut`, the device `st` suite, `gate-report` and `pr-ready-gate` were all green, with `mergeable_state: clean`. The `pr-ready` label remains on the PR, so this rebase re-runs the same suites including `st`.

Before that, `pr-ready-gate` was the only red check on `2023105a`, and it failed solely because the PR did not yet carry the `pr-ready` label; its "Require pr-ready and passing suites" step exits 1 by design until a maintainer starts the device ST.

A real-model server comparison was completed on 2026-11-05 against **`d6267623`**, which is now superseded. Those measurements are historical and were **not** re-run on the rebased head; see the section below.

No linked issue; this follows the prompt-footprint investigation.

## Real-model server validation (2026-11-05, historical — pre-rebase head)

**Result: real requests are smaller; this sample does not establish a stable TTFT improvement or behavioral equivalence.** Applies to baseline `9bef53ee` versus PR head `d6267623` only, not to the current rebased head.

### Setup

- Existing internal MaaS route, `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`, in `adx-jiuwen-test-0`. Both arms used the same temporary Pod/node, 4 CPU / 8 GiB, and image digest `sha256:10de3e3eb648fcb1a3c1714ea3fc2a16ec0f8660fde897f3717f783b02f23727`.
- Both arms used identical copies of the installed WorkSwarm package, differing only in the three PR implementation files (`prompts.py`, `rail.py`, `tool_display.py`); import paths and file hashes were verified inside the Pod.
- Eight real product tasks: two samples per arm per case, in adjacent baseline→PR and PR→baseline order. Each used a new session with an already warm process; no warmups or task retries. SHORT-CODE reused the repository code task and grader; LONG-EDIT extended the repository edit task with a roughly 20 KB query as a stress variant, using its original grader. This is a targeted comparison, not a full benchmark score.

### First-request input size

Counts below were observed on the real product request path. Byte counts are UTF-8 bytes, not characters; token counts come from provider usage.

| Case | Request body, baseline → PR | System text, baseline → PR | Tool schemas, baseline → PR | Prompt tokens, baseline → PR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SHORT-CODE | 131,760 → 102,382 B (−29,378 B) | 54,175 → 33,480 B | 55,553 → 47,112 B | 30,134–30,166 → 24,017–24,051 (~20% lower) |
| LONG-EDIT | 173,016 → 122,828 B (−50,188 B) | 74,621 → 33,480 B | 55,553 → 47,112 B | 40,909–40,951 → 29,436–29,474 (~28% lower) |

### First-request TTFT

TTFT means the first nonempty model delta. All eight samples first emitted a **reasoning** delta; this is not time to the first user-visible answer. Samples are listed in execution order within each arm.

| Case / arm | TTFT samples (seconds) | Interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| SHORT-CODE / baseline | 2.3522, 2.6027 | Median 2.4774 s |
| SHORT-CODE / PR | 2.4359, 2.4905 | Median 2.4632 s; only 14.2 ms lower, within observed variation |
| LONG-EDIT / baseline | 5.6430, **15.3655*** | Second sample was flagged `measurement_valid=false` |
| LONG-EDIT / PR | 3.8872, 2.8851 | Only one complete valid adjacent baseline/PR pair remains |

The valid long-query pair was **5.6430 → 3.8872 s** (−1.7558 s, about 31%). That is one pair, not an established improvement. The other pair was PR 2.8851 s followed by the flagged baseline 15.3655 s; it is retained here but excluded from the valid-pair claim.

\* The flagged run had an auxiliary `CancelledError`; all seven foreground model calls returned HTTP 200. This does not by itself demonstrate a MaaS outage. No foreground HTTP failures were observed, but gateway queue/prefill timing was unavailable, so service variation cannot be ruled out. The much larger all-sample long-query median difference must not be treated as attributable acceleration.

### Correctness, limits and cleanup

- Original repository graders: **PR 4/4 passed; baseline 3/4 passed**. One baseline SHORT-CODE run did not modify the source and failed its existing tests. All eight tasks retained all 24 direct tools. These small samples show no observed PR regression; they do not prove unchanged model behavior across tasks.
- Query deduplication and `call_goal` shortening were tested together. Separate live-model contribution measurements were not run. Provider cache counts also varied; a new session is not proof of a cold provider cache. Later same-session turns and process cold start were not measured.
- The PR-only `prompt_hashes` field was not found in the collected session state/trace. Its runtime emission is **not confirmed** by this run; arm identity was established by implementation file hashes instead. The offline provenance regressions above remain separate evidence.
- The internal gateway accounted for **$1.9399712**, against a $2 task cap; the soft stop prevented optional additional arms. No personal paid key was used and no new provider was added.
- The temporary virtual key was revoked (subsequent access returned 401). The test Pod, three ConfigMaps and one Secret were deleted with UID preconditions and read back as absent; all eight WorkSwarm sessions were deleted and returned `NOT_FOUND`. Task-local DSH sessions and scratch files were removed after retaining sanitized timing/usage/grader evidence and source fingerprints locally. No credentials or private service endpoints are included here.


## Issue 追溯关联
<!-- weekly-pr-backfill:2026-11-02:prompt-redundancy -->
Refs #923 — [Feature]: 减少记忆与工具提示重复输入并记录每次模型尝试的 Prompt 版本.

此 Issue 按维护者要求补建，用于追踪已合入工作的需求、设计和验证记录；关联不代表本次重新测试或新增未修复问题。

555.author: lh913137941
555.body:
## Summary

The phone now has a configurable, fail-closed path to report the device-observed half of the
`#production-metrics` data, and the personal-agent service has an opt-in receiver that stores it
separately from the Gateway's production snapshot.

- **Outbox** (`cloud-adapter`: `DigitalMateClientMetrics.ets`): bounded in-memory queue of
  finalized turns, deduped by `trace_id`, with the board's per-call fields
  (`model`, `status`, `duration_ms`, `ttft_ms`, `tpot_ms`, token counts, `stream`). Cloud
  `task.profiling` model calls are attached by `task_id`, either before or after the local turn
  finalizes.
- **Reporter** (`entry`: `DigitalMateTelemetryReporter.ets`): HTTPS POST with the current Gateway
  session token and CA, 5 s debounce, exponential backoff, redirect refusal, bounded response.
  Missing endpoint, `401/403/404/405/501` and a rejected payload never enter the chat path.
- **Context**: trajectory now records coarse `region` (system region, e.g. `CN`) and `timezone`
  (`Asia/Shanghai`) plus `client_sent_at_ms`; no location permission, IP, SSID or device identifier.
- **Runtime**: `DigitalMateTaskRuntime` enables reporting from local config and stops it on logout;
  both turn and model-call reporting stay behind the existing “性能记录” opt-in.
- **Receiver** (`harness/personal-agent` `agent_bridge`): opt-in `POST /digitalmate/telemetry`
  that validates the contract and writes only normalized fields to a per-deployment SQLite store.

## Wire contract

`POST` JSON body, schema `digitalmate-client-metrics@1`, scope **`client-observed`**:

```json
{"schema":"digitalmate-client-metrics@1","scope":"client-observed",
 "environment":"adx-jiuwen-test-0","generated_at_ms":1762300000000,
 "turns":[{"trace_id":"tr-1-...","task_id":"task-...","request_id":"digitalmate-...",
   "action":"room.message","outcome":"completed","network_type":"wifi",
   "app_version":"x.y.z","region":"CN","timezone":"Asia/Shanghai",
   "message_chars":12,"started_at_ms":0,"client_sent_at_ms":0,"ended_at_ms":0,
   "attempts":1,"request_bytes":0,"response_bytes":0,
   "timings":{"tap_ms":0,"queued_ms":0,"dequeued_ms":0,"wire_send_ms":0,
              "ack_ms":0,"first_text_ms":0,"last_text_ms":0,
              "task_done_ms":0,"display_done_ms":0},
   "model_calls":[{"model":"DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017","status":"ok",
     "duration_ms":1200,"ttft_ms":300,"tpot_ms":12.5,
     "input_tokens":900,"output_tokens":120,"total_tokens":1020,"stream":true}]}]}
```

No message text, attachments, prompt/response content, credentials or local identifiers are sent.

## Receiver

`server_engine/engine_client_telemetry.py`, mounted from `create_app` only when the deployment sets
a directory:

| Variable | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_DIR` | Enables the route and holds `client-observed.sqlite3`; unset means no route (the fail-closed client stops). |
| `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_RETENTION_DAYS` | Retention for `received_at_ms`, default 30, clamped to 1..365. |
| `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_EXPORT_TOKEN` | Enables the aggregate-only read route for the dashboard collector; unset means that route is 404. |

- Authorization mirrors `/digitalmate/ws`: Gateway mode requires a Bearer token and validates the
  Origin, and refuses `digitalmate-tool.`/`orp_` scoped credentials; otherwise `authorize_client`
  applies (loopback or `DIGITALMATE_ACCESS_TOKEN`).
- Strict validation: schema/scope, ≤20 turns per batch, ≤32 model calls per turn, ≤256 KiB body.
  Unknown keys are dropped, never stored; there is no path from a device field into
  `classified-production`.
- Idempotent by `(trace_id, task_id, request_id, started_at_ms)`, so a retried batch writes once and
  two devices whose local counters coincide cannot overwrite each other. Writes are normalized
  columns plus JSON; the raw request body is never kept.
- A client-claimed `environment` is **untrusted** and stored only as `client_environment` for
  diagnosis; the deployment identity is the store directory. Write failure → `503` (the device
  retries); invalid batch → `400` (the device drops it). An unwritable directory logs a warning and
  leaves the product service running without metrics.

### Aggregate read for the dashboard

Setting `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_EXPORT_TOKEN` mounts `GET /digitalmate/telemetry/summary?days=N`
(default 7 days, clamped to the retention window). It accepts **only** that deployment secret
(constant-time compare) and refuses device `digitalmate-tool.`/`orp_` credentials, so a device
credential never reads aggregates. The response, `client-observed-aggregate@1`:

- `turns`/`outcomes`/`networks` — turn count, completion and network mix;
- `client_ttft` — click-to-first-text duration (count/avg/p50/p95);
- `end_to_end` — click-to-rendered duration;
- `segments` — the eight stages derived from consecutive client marks;
- `models` — calls, successes, streamed calls, TTFT/TPOT distributions and token sums per model.

It contains no `trace_id`, `task_id`, `request_id`, message content or client-claimed
environment label; the dashboard collector labels each deployment from its own configuration.

## Local configuration (never committed)

`app_config.json` → `digitalmate`:

```json
{"telemetryUrl":"https://<same host as url>/digitalmate/telemetry",
 "telemetryEnvironment":"adx-jiuwen-test-0"}
```

`telemetryUrl` absent disables reporting. Cross-host, plain-HTTP, query or fragment URLs and
malformed environment labels are rejected at startup by both the app and `sync-app-config.mjs`.
No token from the test-environment announcement is stored in the repository; each device keeps
using the Gateway login credential it already has.

## Trust boundary

Device data is advisory only. It is sent as `client-observed` and must never be merged into the
trusted `classified-production` snapshot, which continues to come exclusively from LiteLLM
`/spend/logs/v2` with `traffic_type=production`. `request_id` is included for correlation only and
must be stripped from any published dashboard snapshot.

## Verification

- `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-client-metrics.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-telemetry-reporter.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-trajectory.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-config.test.mjs tests/unit/sync-app-config.test.mjs` — 49 passed.
- Related suites (`digitalmate-notifications`, `digitalmate-stop-control`, `digitalmate-task-runtime-memory`, `digitalmate-shared-binding`, `digitalmate-device-st`, `digitalmate-profiling`, `digitalmate-gateway-auth`) — 156 passed.
- `pytest tests/test_client_telemetry.py` (personal-agent `agent_bridge`) — 21 passed, covering
  normalization, idempotency, retention, the 404/400/413/403/202 route behaviour, Gateway and
  private auth modes, the unwritable-directory fallback, and the aggregate's TTFT/segment/model
  arithmetic, window, privacy and export-token behaviour.
- Four pre-existing failures in `test_bridge.py`, `test_bridge_startup_imports.py` and
  `test_bridge_shutdown.py` on this branch are unrelated (`Bridge.dispatch_guest` and
  `_claude_hooks` do not exist here; one fixture needs `server_engine` installed).
- Full `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs` is not fully runnable in this worktree: tests that need
  the untracked `node_modules` (`typescript`, `playwright`) fail on `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`
  independently of this change.
- No device build, live upload, deployment to the five test environments or production validation
  has been performed.

## Dashboard side

Companion PR: `agent-CI-Infra/dashboard#28`. It reads the aggregate into a separate
`client-observed-metrics@1` file and a separate 「端侧观测」 tab: KPI tiles, end-to-end segment
bars, an environment comparison table and a model comparison table with an environment selector.
It shares no file, schema or rendering path with the `classified-production` view, publishes no
identifiers or message content, and labels environments from the deployment configuration rather
than from device claims. A deployment that cannot be read on a run reuses its last record marked
as a historical snapshot.

## Still required

1. Deploy the receiver to the test environments with `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_DIR` and
   `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_EXPORT_TOKEN`, and verify the phone → store → dashboard path end to end.
2. Merge the companion dashboard change.

Keep this PR in **draft** until the receiver is deployed and verified end to end.

559.author: HugoXK
559.body:
## 做了什么

主屏任务浮层 `WaterfallTaskOverlay.ets` 的三个可点控件，父节点都有 `.accessibilityText(...)` 标签，但**父节点内部的纯装饰图标**没标 `.accessibilityLevel('no')`，读屏念完标签后会紧接着再停一个「图片/符号」（ArkUI 里 `.accessibilityText` 不合并子树）。同文件另外三处（`statusIcon()` 的两个图标、预览行的 `chevron_down`）已经标了 `'no'`，所以这是漏标，不是新规矩。

本 PR 只补三处，不动布局、尺寸、文案、`onClick`：

- 收起按钮里的 `SymbolGlyph($r('sys.symbol.xmark'))`
- 结果摘要行里的旋转箭头 `Image($r('app.media.arrow_up'))`
- 继续追问按钮里的 `Image($r('app.media.arrow_up'))`

因为这三个图标没有 `onClick`，不属于 `check-a11y` 的 unnamed tap target，`tests/unit/a11y-baseline.json` **一行未改**。

## Reachability（release 路径）

`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:9244` 实例化 `WaterfallTaskOverlay({...})`，随 A2uiHome 首页渲染；任务执行中/结束时浮层出现在主屏上方。整条链上没有任何 debug 闸门或 build 变量开关。

## 证据

**红（pristine `3802d46e`，干净 worktree，只放本 PR 的测试文件）**

```
$ git worktree add --detach pristine 3802d46e
$ cp tests/unit/waterfall-task-overlay-a11y.test.mjs pristine/tests/unit/
$ cd pristine && node --test tests/unit/waterfall-task-overlay-a11y.test.mjs
ℹ tests 7 · pass 4 · fail 3
✖ the sheet close button hides its decorative xmark glyph
  AssertionError: the sheet close button: its SymbolGlyph child at line 164 has no .accessibilityLevel('no'),
  so the screen reader announces a bare symbolglyph right after the wrapper label
✖ the result summary row hides its decorative arrow
  AssertionError: the result summary row: its Image child at line 182 has no .accessibilityLevel('no'), …
✖ the follow-up send button hides its decorative arrow
  AssertionError: the follow-up send button: its Image child at line 197 has no .accessibilityLevel('no'), …
exit=1
```

这三条是「缺 `.accessibilityLevel('no')`」的断言失败，不是节点没定位到（每条都回显了它切到的节点与行号）。红证据所在的提交是 `dc93bd821eb75dfab88661329abf2432f698bce4`（本分支第一个 commit，只含测试文件），该 commit 在 fork 上可直接取。

**绿（本 PR head）**

```
$ node --test tests/unit/waterfall-task-overlay-a11y.test.mjs
ℹ tests 7 · pass 7 · fail 0   exit=0

$ node --test tests/unit/waterfall-task-overlay-a11y.test.mjs tests/unit/a11y-gate.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-task-card-a11y.test.mjs
ℹ tests 34 · pass 34 · fail 0
```

**载重（变异检查）**

```
# M0 修复后
ℹ tests 7 · pass 7 · fail 0
# M1 只删掉 xmark 那行的 .accessibilityLevel('no')
✖ the sheet close button hides its decorative xmark glyph
ℹ tests 7 · pass 6 · fail 1
# M2 还原
ℹ tests 7 · pass 7 · fail 0
```

**gate**

```
$ node scripts/check-a11y.mjs
Files with unnamed tap targets: 28 known, 0 new or worse, 0 stale.   exit=0
```

修复前后都是这条（这三个图标不是 tap target），`tests/unit/a11y-baseline.json` 未改动。

## 改动范围

- 允许改（本 PR 实际改动）：`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/components/WaterfallTaskOverlay.ets`、新增 `tests/unit/waterfall-task-overlay-a11y.test.mjs`。
- 禁止改（本 PR 未触碰）：`scripts/check-a11y.mjs`、`scripts/ci/*`、任何 `tests/st/*`、`tests/unit/a11y-baseline.json`、`pages/CloudHome/SessionDrawer.ets`（仍由 open PR #551 占用），以及其它被 open PR 占用的文件。
- 基于 `3802d46e`，改动 2 文件、`+207 / −1`（其中生产代码 +3/−1）。

## 风险与回滚

- 风险：low。只加三个无障碍属性，无逻辑分支、无数据/网络/权限改动，不改变布局与命中区。
- 回滚：`git revert 4efccba`（或整分支关闭），无数据迁移。
- 未覆盖：沙箱无 ArkTS SDK、无真机，**没有在设备上录过 TalkBack/VoiceOver 的实际播报顺序**；结论来自源码级静态断言 + ArkUI `.accessibilityText` / `.accessibilityLevel` 的语义。真机上若发现图标仍被朗读，需要补一次设备核对。

Fixes #558

## 评审与风险

- Reviewer：**92/100，不阻塞可合**（COMMENT 已发：评论 `6628399167`；本环境无独立 reviewer 身份，评论由 Lead 用实现账号代发并在正文注明 self-review disclosure；未 approve、未 merge）。
- Security：**risk: low**（评论 `6628373046`）：只新增 3 个无障碍属性，无新 import/网络/存储/权限；`accessibilityLevel('no')` 只移出组件自身，不影响父节点标签与 onClick；被隐藏的都是纯装饰叶子图标，没有把 `task.prompt` / `task.reply` 拼进朗读文本。
- Test：独立在 pristine `3802d46e` 上跑出 `4 pass / 3 fail`，另做三段变异（评论 `6628351969`）。

560.author: lh913137941
560.body:
## What

Adds a **按请求 ID 查询** card to the 模型指标 tab of `dashboard/e2e-performance`. Paste a gateway `request_id` to see that single call's:

- 模型 / 状态 / 调用类型
- 网关总耗时、TTFT、TPOT
- 输入 / 输出 / 总 Token
- 花费（USD，仅网关查询结果）与请求时间范围

## Lookup order

1. **本地快照优先** — the already-loaded ~24h `model-request-metrics.json` snapshot (`state.productionDoc`, matched on `request_id`).
2. **网关直查** — if not in the snapshot and the user has provided the prod admin key, the browser queries `https://onlineswarm.openjiuwen.com:31474/spend/logs?request_id=...` directly (gateway sends `access-control-allow-origin: *` and allows the `authorization` header, so this works browser-direct).

## Security design

- The page ships **keyless**; the admin key comes only from user input and is kept solely in browser `localStorage` — never written into page code, the repo, or any server.
- Rendering is restricted to an allowlist of metric fields; request messages/responses are never displayed.
- Collector now records `request_id` as the first field of each snapshot call row so the local lookup can match on it.

## Tests

- New vm-sliced test: row/call normalization (TTFT/TPOT computation), local hit/miss, HTML allowlist rendering, error mapping — `node --test tests/e2e/workflow/model-metrics-dashboard.test.mjs` 29/29 green.
- `node --check` on app.js.

Stacked on `codex/e2e-stage-breakdown` (#535). The same feature is mirrored to the embedded board copy in agent-CI-Infra/dashboard (PR there references this commit).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

562.author: HugoXK
562.body:
## 问题

读屏在每个返回按钮后面多停一个「图片」节点，同一个控件被念两遍；心上事列表里每条记录后面也一样多一个停靠点。父节点已经有可读名，缺的是把纯装饰的箭头图标移出无障碍树：

- `pages/A2uiHome/components/common/A2uiButtonView.ets` 的 `shape === 'back'` 分支：`Button` 内 `Image($r('app.media.icon_back'))`，父 `Button` 已有 `.accessibilityText(label || '返回')`。该组件被 6 个返回按钮复用（`ComposioAuthPage`、`HomePage`、`TrainPresalePanel`、`ConfigPage`、`A2uiHome/Index.ets`、`SharedWaterfallCard`）。
- `pages/A2uiHome/components/BimDetailPage.ets` 的 `Header()`：44×44 返回 `Stack` 内 `Image(icon_back)`，父 `Stack` 已有 `.accessibilityText('返回心上事列表')`。
- `pages/A2uiHome/components/BimHomePage.ets` 的 `@Builder RecordRow`：记录行尾部的装饰箭头（`.rotate({ angle: 180 })`），父 `Row` 已有拼接的 `.accessibilityText(...)`，**每条记录**都多一个「图片」停靠点。

## 修法

三处 `Image($r('app.media.icon_back'))` 各追加 `.accessibilityLevel('no')`，父节点的 `accessibilityText`、`onClick`、尺寸、颜色、事件一律不动。`accessibilityLevel('no')` 只把组件自身移出无障碍树（`'no-hide-descendants'` 才隐子树），与本文件族既有写法一致（`WaterfallTaskOverlay.ets` 的 `statusIcon()` 等）。

## 可达性

- 共享返回按钮：6 个调用点都在 release 的 `build()` 路径上（见上方文件列表），无 debug 闸门。
- 心上事：`HomePage.onOpenBim` → `A2uiHome/Index.openBimRoot()`（`showBimPage = true`）→ `BimSpace()` → `BimHomePage`（列表）→ `onOpenRecord` → `openBimDetail()` → `BimDetailPage`。`isDebugBuild` 只作用于 sentinel mock 与 feed 调试，不作用于这两个页面。

## 测试

先红后修：测试 `tests/unit/back-button-icon-a11y.test.mjs` 读真 `.ets` 源码，按块定位到每个具体节点，断言图标的修饰链带 `.accessibilityLevel('no')`，并断言父节点的可读名/点击不被改坏。

```text
# pristine 3802d46e（只有测试）
$ node --test tests/unit/back-button-icon-a11y.test.mjs
✖ the shared back button hides its decorative arrow (1.335359ms)
✖ the heart-things detail back control hides its decorative arrow (0.743464ms)
✖ the heart-things record row hides its decorative arrow (0.908886ms)
ℹ tests 5
ℹ pass 2
ℹ fail 3
✖ failing tests:
✖ the shared back button hides its decorative arrow (1.335359ms)
AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: the A2uiButtonView back button: its Image child at line 91 has no .accessibilityLevel('no'), so the screen reader announces a bare image right after the wrapper label
✖ the heart-things detail back control hides its decorative arrow (0.743464ms)
```

```text
# 修复后
$ node --test tests/unit/back-button-icon-a11y.test.mjs
ℹ tests 5
ℹ pass 5
ℹ fail 0
```

基线不动（`check-a11y` 只统计未命名点击目标，隐藏装饰子节点不改变计数）：

$ node scripts/check-a11y.mjs

563.author: HugoXK
563.body:
Fixes #449

## 问题

英文设备的用户走的是同一条云端连接状态链路，但连接横幅的文本与动作按钮都是硬编码中文：读屏聚焦横幅时整块播报未翻译的中文状态（例如「正在连接云端…」），英文用户看到的按钮是「重新加载」「正在连接」「立即重试」，既读不懂当前状态，也不知道按下去会重连。连接链路其余文案都经 `digitalmateUserFacingError()` / `digitalmateBusinessError()` 收敛成可读句子，唯独这一处把中文字面量直接渲染进 `Text` 与 `Button`，没有任何语言分支。

## 修法

- `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets`：`digitalmateConnectBanner()` 与 `digitalmateUserFacingError()` 增加可选 `language` 参数（默认 `'zh-CN'`），`en` 开头（`/^en\b/i`）输出英文，其它语言逐字节维持现状；新增 `digitalmateConnectionActionLabel(kind, language)` 统一产出三个按钮文案（`reload` / `connecting` / `retry`）。`digitalmateBusinessError()` 的透传分支保持原样——服务端业务原文不翻译。
- `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionBanner.ets`：组件字段初始化器里取一次 `digitalmateClientContext().language`（不进 `aboutToAppear`，既有 banner fixture 不受影响）（仓库现有唯一语言入口，与 `model/DigitalMateDeviceContext.ets` 同源），把该语言传给横幅文案、`accessibilityText` 与三个按钮文案；显隐条件、重试逻辑、样式与 5 秒 slow 定时器不变。
## 未纳入本 PR

- 客户端自有文案经调用方传入、仍未英文化的一批：`'正在同步云端会话…'`（会话加载中）与网关恢复态的两句 `'正在恢复云端连接…'` / `'云端连接暂不可用，请重试连接'`（`pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets` 的 `beginGatewayRecover()` 与横幅入参）。这句是客户端自有文案，但走的是 `digitalmateBusinessError()` 的业务消息透传分支，因此本 PR 的 `language` 参数管不到它——英文设备在这一态仍会看到中文状态，按钮已是英文 `Reload`。
- 本轮不改的原因：该文件同时被多项未合入 PR 占用（本 PR 开题时抓取的占用快照命中 `#334`、`#391`、`#441`、`#474`、`#481`、`#555`），改它会与这些 PR 直接冲突。
- 已建独立 tracking issue 跟进：见 #564（含改法、验收标准与前置占用清单）。
- 范围确认：`#563` 的生产代码只改 `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 与 `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionBanner.ets`，不碰 `pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets`。

- **二次本地化兜底（F1）**：调用方会先把错误本地化成中文再存进 `this.error`（`pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets`、`DigitalMateConversationBinding.ets`），横幅再以英文渲染时原本会原样透出中文。现在 `DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 持有本模块**自有文案**的 zh→en 对照（10 条 + `正在重新连接云端（第 N 次）…` 正则），英文路径先查表再走正则；`state === 'open'` 的业务透传分支只在命中自有文案时才替换，**服务端 / 模型原文照旧原样透传**。英文路径同时把 `证书|certificate|SSL|TLS` 提到 `网络|…` 之前，避免 TLS 失败被报成「网络不可用」；中文路径的判定顺序一字未改。
- 共 2 个生产文件，不动 `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConversationBinding.ets`（被 #481 占用），不碰 `cloud-adapter/.../CloudMarkdown.ets`（#547 / #403）。

## 可达性

1. `entryability/EntryAbility.ets` 冷启动 `loadContent('pages/A2uiHome/Index')`。
2. `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets` 的 `CloudConversationBody()` 在 `cloudBackend === 'digitalmate'` 时渲染 `DigitalMateConversationBinding`；该后端是默认值（`resources/rawfile/app_config.example.json` 的 `"cloudBackend": "digitalmate"`）。
3. `DigitalMateConversationBinding` 的 `build()` 里 `if (this.state !== 'open' || this.error)` 渲染本组件，而 `state` 初值为 `'closed'`——冷启动第一帧横幅必然出现；断开、超时、重连中也走同一分支。
4. 全屏会话页 `pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets` 也直接使用同一组件，两个入口共用这份文案。

## 测试

先红后修：`tests/unit/connection-banner-bilingual.test.mjs` 把 `DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 去掉类型后在 vm 里**真执行**（不复制实现），并静态守卫组件装配。

```text
# 红基线 eb1408de（= f69d6335 + 只有测试）
$ node --test tests/unit/connection-banner-bilingual.test.mjs
✖ every Chinese sentence the module emits is translated when it is fed back in English
✖ a caller that localises the error first still gets English from the banner, and server text is untouched
✖ the four stored Chinese errors still read in English when a caller pre-localised them
ℹ tests 10 · pass 7 · fail 3
```

```text
# 最终 head 5de0ad69
$ node --test tests/unit/connection-banner-bilingual.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-connection-ux.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-connection-banner.test.mjs
ℹ tests 21 · pass 21 · fail 0 · skipped 0
```

基线不动：`node scripts/check-a11y.mjs` → `Files with unnamed tap targets: 28 known, 0 new or worse, 0 stale.`

残留（未验证，不当成已验证）：英文串若再被喂回 `digitalmateUserFacingError()` 会被二次分类——`'Reconnecting to the cloud (attempt 2)…'` 含 `econn`（Reconnecting 的子串）、`'Secure connection failed…'` 含 `network`，都会被判成网络失败。当前路径不可达（banner 的 `connecting` 分支直接返回，不做二次分类），中文侧不受影响，故本 PR 不改；但不视为「已验证安全」。

未验证（不伪造）：真机 TalkBack / VoiceOver 的实际朗读与 `.accessibilityGroup(true)` 下的焦点顺序——沙箱没有 HarmonyOS 设备，只做了源码级执行断言。另有一处新增调用语境：本 PR 让组件在**字段初始化器**里调用 `digitalmateClientContext()`，即仓库里第一次在 UI 构造期调用 `i18n.System.getSystemLocaleInstance()`（其余 6 个调用点都在提交/发送路径），其构造期异常行为未经真机验证。

## 回归护栏（变异验证）

568.body:
Fixes #567

## 改了什么（生产 +2 / −0，一个文件）

`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/SkillCenter/Detail.ets`

- `:465` `Toggle({ type: ToggleType.Switch, isOn: this.enabledState })` → 修饰链加 `.accessibilityText('启用该技能')`（名字落在 `:466`；`Toggle` 在 base `48435d43` 与 head 都是 `:465`）；
- `:471` `Text('···')`（base 上是 `:470`，本 PR 在它上方插了一行后为 `:471`；`.bindMenu(this.overflowActions())` 在 `:476`）→ 修饰链加 `.accessibilityText('更多操作')`（名字落在 `:475`）。

两处都照仓库既有写法，不新增约定：`pages/A2uiHome/components/TrainPresalePanel.ets:1061`（同型开关带 `.accessibilityText('授权提交真实未支付订单')`）、`pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets:3075`（`.accessibilityText('更多操作 ' + file.name).bindMenu(...)`）。

## 用户问题

技能详情页（`main_pages.json:10` 注册，`SkillCenterView.ets:29` 经 `router.pushUrl` 进入，渲染条件 `this.phase === 'ready'`，无 debug 闸门）顶部两个控件没有可读名：开关只播报「开关，开 / 关」，`···` 被念成「点 点 点」。`···` 是「发布到技能市场」「卸载」的唯一入口，读屏用户因此找不到卸载入口，也判断不出开关在控制什么。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/skillcenter-detail-a11y.test.mjs`（当前 head 上 187 行；红 commit `bb5c0f70` 上是首版 176 行，`626e5d20` 按评审 F1 放宽了 `Text('···')` 定位器的引号）。它复用 `scripts/check-a11y.mjs` 导出的 `stripComments` 与自写的链扫描，把名字断言在**该控件自己的修饰链**上——写在文件别处不能糊弄过去；同时断言两个定位点各只有 1 处、仍在 `if (this.phase === 'ready')` 块内、且没有互相借用名字。不依赖网络与 ArkTS SDK。

```
红基线 bb5c0f70（只有测试）: tests 3 / pass 1 / fail 2
  ✖ the enable switch is named 启用该技能 on its own chain
  ✖ the overflow trigger is named 更多操作 on the chain that opens the menu
修复后 626e5d20:            tests 3 / pass 3 / fail 0
用最终测试文件在 48435d43 上重跑: tests 3 / pass 1 / fail 2（同两条红名，与红基线一致）
node --test tests/unit/a11y-gate.test.mjs → tests 22 / pass 22 / fail 0
node scripts/check-a11y.mjs → Files with unnamed tap targets: 28 known, 0 new or worse, 0 stale.
git diff bb5c0f70 74376ff3 -- tests/unit/skillcenter-detail-a11y.test.mjs → 空（红→修之间测试文件未动）
626e5d20 是评审后的一条 test-only 跟进：git diff --quiet 74376ff3 626e5d20 -- '*.ets' → PROD-UNCHANGED，只让 locator 同时接受 '···' 与 "···" 两种引号（评审 F1：避免格式化后误报「控件不存在」而不是「名字不对」）。
```

`check-a11y` 数字不变是预期：门禁的 `UNNAMEABLE` 只含容器与裸形状，`Toggle` 与作为可点目标的 `Text` 不在其中；`--json` 上该文件仍是 `taps 11 / unnamed 4`，总数 28，`violations []`、`stale []`。

## 回归护栏（变异验证，都在本分支实跑）

| 变异 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| M1 删掉 Toggle 的 `.accessibilityText('启用该技能')` | 1 红（switch 断言） |
| M2 删掉 `Text('···')` 的 `.accessibilityText('更多操作')` | 1 红（overflow 断言） |
| M3 把 `'更多操作'` 改成 `'更多'` | 1 红（overflow 断言） |
| M4 把 Toggle 的名字挪到 `Text('···')` 的链上 | 2 红（两条断言各自抓住，证明测的是节点不是字符串） |
| M5 源码里 `Text('···')` 改成 `Text("···")`（名字仍在） | 3/3 绿（locator 容忍另一种引号，说明 F1 的修法是放宽 locator、不是删断言） |
| M6 同上改双引号且删掉名字 | 1 红，报「必须带 `.accessibilityText('更多操作')`」，不是「找不到控件」 |

每次变异后还原并复跑 3/3 绿；每次回读被改行逐字符确认只动了预期字符。

## 未纳入本 PR

`Detail.ets` 另有 4 个无名可点目标（`node scripts/check-a11y.mjs --json` 实测：该文件 11 个可点、4 个无名，`heads` 为 `Stack`/`Stack`/`Row`/`Stack`），属于 `tests/unit/a11y-baseline.json` 里已复核的既有基线债务；本轮**不动基线**（该文件被 open PR #551 占用，另 #557 也改它），也不在本 PR 修这 4 处。基线文件本身就是这份债务的台账。

## 评审跟进

- Reviewer：`74376ff3` 上 92/100（F1 = 定位器只认单引号）；**最终 `626e5d20` 上 93/100（`Scored on 626e5d20`，只 COMMENT，未 approve，无必须改项）**，F1 判 closed，生产码 `PROD-UNCHANGED`（sha256 相同）。F2（`check-a11y` 不认 `bindMenu` 触发点，属门禁盲区）不在本 PR 范围，留作后续门禁改进；F3（同文件 4 个无名可点目标）就是上面「未纳入本 PR」那段基线债务。
- Test / Security 的回执见 PR 评论；生产码自 `74376ff3` 起的增量与对 `626e5d20` 的复跑结论同见评论。

## 未验证（不当作已验证）

- 沙箱没有 ArkTS SDK，也没有 HarmonyOS 设备：**未编译、未在真机验证 VoiceOver/TalkBack 的实际朗读**。补名之后部分系统版本可能用名称替代「开关」角色播报，名称与开/关状态是否同时朗读需设备确认一次。
- CI/check 状态按实况记录（见最终回执），排队中的一律写 queued/pending，不挪用任何旧 head 的结论。
- 关联 issue #567 仍带 `needs-template`：沙箱无 HarmonyOS 设备与截图工具，Bug 模板要求的截图/录屏无法提供；已用源码级证据（`Detail.ets:465`/`:470` 两处修饰链、`check-a11y --json` 该文件 11 个可点 / 4 个无名）代替，**未贴伪造图片**，也未手动摘除该标签。

## 风险与回滚

`risk: low` — 只加两个修饰属性，不改结构、事件、样式与文案；无新依赖、无权限/配置/网络变更，不触碰被其它 PR 占用的文件。回滚 = 关闭本 PR，无数据迁移。

## 公共 Benchmark 整体效果（六项修复 A/B 配对）

评测：2026-11-05，A = `7c458d6` 基线，B = 同基线 + 本批六项修复；
test-0 · 2 CPU / 2 GiB · DeepSeek；公共文本题 56/56 次调用，28/28 对同题配对。

![基线汇总](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f1aa31e0ed77f7609646935947c84441de0c74bb/docs/developer_guide/evidence/tool-mcp-fixes-2026-11-05/benchmark-paired/54-baseline-public-benchmark.png?raw=true)

**结论：本批改动的可测收益是正确率与 token 效率，端到端墙钟时间没有可辨识变化。**

| 指标 | A 基线 | B 优化后 | 变化 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Pi-Bench pass@1 | 76.9% (10/13) | **92.3% (12/13)** | +15.4pt |
| VitaBench 2.0 pass@1 | 77.8% (7/9) | **88.9% (8/9)** | +11.1pt |
| PAST-Bench pass@1 | 100.0% (6/6) | 100.0% (6/6) | — |
| 有效配对输入 token（21 对） | 1,512,106 | 1,388,751 | **−8.16%** |
| 前台模型调用（21 对） | 47 | 42 | −10.6% |
| 同 21 对端到端耗时 | 796.77s | 814.02s | +2.2%（中位数 +0.00s） |

3 道题由 FAIL 转 PASS（`PIB-FINANCIER-016`、`PIB-RESEARCHER-003`、`VTB-E941775-2`），
28 对中无 PASS→FAIL 倒退。

耗时一项**不作为收益声明**，原因是它的离散度盖过了信号：
在调用次数相同且 token 变化 <2% 的 15 对里，墙钟差值范围是 **−81.59s … +56.47s**、
中位数 **+0.00s**；`PIB-RESEARCHER-018` 两组同为 1 次调用、token 仅差 1.2%，
耗时却从 127.17s 变成 45.58s。对官方 21 对做敏感性检查，仅剔除 1 个样本，
合计结论就在 −5.3% 与 +14.8% 之间翻转，说明样本量不足以判断墙钟方向。

汇总表中的 p50 / p95 覆盖各条件下的全部试验，正确率提升会改变参与统计的题目集合，
两列并非同题对照，因此不宜读作"变慢"。

方法与完整配对明细：[benchmark-paired/README.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f1aa31e0ed77f7609646935947c84441de0c74bb/docs/developer_guide/evidence/tool-mcp-fixes-2026-11-05/benchmark-paired/README.md)

同一会话先发送文件，再修改原路径内容后再次发送时，原来的“session + 路径”去重会跳过更新文件。现在按会话、路径和明确的投递目标集合，记录最后一次成功交付的内容摘要；相同内容仍去重，更新内容和 A→B→A 回退可以重新交付。

仅在 Runtime push 成功后记录版本；失败、异常、取消仍可重试。受管文件使用实际封存资产的摘要，避免源文件在推送期间变化后误记版本。保留执行授权、会话清理和原始导入清单，单独更新本次源码 override。

成本：发送前增加流式 SHA256 读取，不宣称是零开销。该 PR 解决交付正确性，不声明整任务提速。

来源：工具/MCP优化调查。该分支独立基于官方 main `10d13f12`，不包含其他修复、benchmark脚手架、模型凭据或原始API回执。没有关联的现有Issue；未合并、未部署。非HarmonyOS/UI改动，未执行设备构建或真机验收。

F1/F2: content hashing now isolates OSError per file, checks regular file types, and uses nonblocking descriptor opening plus fstat to handle replacement races. Added unreadable/retry, disappeared-file, authorized FIFO, and replacement-race tests. 历史固定镜像、每版4个新进程的组件测量：公开校验模块导入中位数约 7.041→0.109 秒。这里不是完整任务计时；收益与 DigitalMate helper 快路径重叠，不能相加。完整 Agent 使用到记忆等能力时仍会加载必要依赖。

## 公共 Benchmark 整体效果（六项修复 A/B 配对）

评测：2026-11-05，A = `7c458d6` 基线，B = 同基线 + 本批六项修复；
test-0 · 2 CPU / 2 GiB · DeepSeek；公共文本题 56/56 次调用，28/28 对同题配对。

![基线汇总](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f1aa31e0ed77f7609646935947c84441de0c74bb/docs/developer_guide/evidence/tool-mcp-fixes-2026-11-05/benchmark-paired/54-baseline-public-benchmark.png?raw=true)

![六项优化后汇总](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f1aa31e0ed77f7609646935947c84441de0c74bb/docs/developer_guide/evidence/tool-mcp-fixes-2026-11-05/benchmark-paired/55-optimized-public-benchmark.png?raw=true)

**结论：本批改动的可测收益是正确率与 token 效率，端到端墙钟时间没有可辨识变化。**

| 指标 | A 基线 | B 优化后 | 变化 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Pi-Bench pass@1 | 76.9% (10/13) | **92.3% (12/13)** | +15.4pt |
| VitaBench 2.0 pass@1 | 77.8% (7/9) | **88.9% (8/9)** | +11.1pt |
| PAST-Bench pass@1 | 100.0% (6/6) | 100.0% (6/6) | — |
| 有效配对输入 token（21 对） | 1,512,106 | 1,388,751 | **−8.16%** |
| 前台模型调用（21 对） | 47 | 42 | −10.6% |
| 同 21 对端到端耗时 | 796.77s | 814.02s | +2.2%（中位数 +0.00s） |

3 道题由 FAIL 转 PASS（`PIB-FINANCIER-016`、`PIB-RESEARCHER-003`、`VTB-E941775-2`），
28 对中无 PASS→FAIL 倒退。

耗时一项**不作为收益声明**，原因是它的离散度盖过了信号：
在调用次数相同且 token 变化 <2% 的 15 对里，墙钟差值范围是 **−81.59s … +56.47s**、
中位数 **+0.00s**；`PIB-RESEARCHER-018` 两组同为 1 次调用、token 仅差 1.2%，
耗时却从 127.17s 变成 45.58s。对官方 21 对做敏感性检查，仅剔除 1 个样本，
合计结论就在 −5.3% 与 +14.8% 之间翻转，说明样本量不足以判断墙钟方向。

汇总表中的 p50 / p95 覆盖各条件下的全部试验，正确率提升会改变参与统计的题目集合，
两列并非同题对照，因此不宜读作"变慢"。

方法与完整配对明细：[benchmark-paired/README.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f1aa31e0ed77f7609646935947c84441de0c74bb/docs/developer_guide/evidence/tool-mcp-fixes-2026-11-05/benchmark-paired/README.md)

Part of #624

---

When a projectless task says “the current directory”, the runtime uses `task/work`, but the system guidance lists the task organization root first. Traces captured file calls to `task/file` while Bash had already found `task/work/file`, adding failed reads and directory-recovery turns.

Make the authoritative runtime cwd the first directory shown, explicitly connect it to user “current directory”, relative file paths and Bash defaults, and distinguish it from the task organization root. Keep explicit user paths, working/output directory roles, permissions, path resolution and filesystem guards unchanged. Apply the guidance in Chinese and English; explicit-project behavior is preserved.

## Validation

- Four real WorkSwarm/agent-core runtime contracts passed, zero skips: bilingual projectless guidance across four local channels, distinct project/cwd, unbound workspace, and stale section removal on channel changes.
- Source verification passed: 2,570 WorkSwarm + 2,894 agent-core files; main's five existing WorkSwarm overrides are retained and this one is appended. Original upstream manifests are unchanged.
- Two synthetic partial-file tasks ran on test-0, 4 CPU/8 GiB, `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`. Both arms used complete main `7c458d669dd5cf59864ad7afb84d240d13af0e8c` packages plus the same five reviewed performance fixes; **only this directory guidance differed**. All parent requests retained 24 direct tools and the same 55,902-byte tool schema.

|Matched, exact-pass pairs|Pairs|Main-model requests, old → new|Main-model input tokens, old → new|
|---|---:|---:|---:|
|6,001-line ledger edit|4|30 → 28|905,953 → 1,342,616|
|5,402-line document edit|3|22 → 18|676,263 → 536,025|
|Total|7|**52 → 46 (-11.5%)**|**1,582,216 → 1,878,641 (+18.7%)**|

Wrong task-root calls and the associated directory recovery calls were each **2 → 0** in this sample. Before-tool-Rail snapshots and execution inputs agree on the file paths: the wrong paths existed before those Rails, rather than being introduced by filesystem resolution. These snapshots are not raw model HTTP responses.

**The input-token increase is a real limitation.** Two new-arm ledger attempts omitted `limit`; each returned the first 2,000 lines (88,410 UTF-8 bytes), not the entire 6,001-line CSV. In attempt 10 the next parent input grew from 29,022 to 78,093 tokens, and subsequent requests retained that context. Ledger pairs added 436,663 input tokens while document pairs saved 140,238, yielding the net +296,425 (+18.7%). The directory prompt itself grew by only 282 UTF-8 bytes. This small sample does not establish that a particular prompt sentence necessarily causes broad reads. Input totals include cached tokens and are not a billing or latency delta. New-arm document attempts still encountered the 256 KiB full-read size guard before switching to grep/ranged reads. This PR does not change default read behavior or those guards, and does not claim overall token, billing, cache, latency or universal performance improvement. Per-pair request counts improved in 3 pairs, stayed equal in 3, and increased in 1. Auxiliary requests are recorded separately and not credited as this change's benefit. The 52/46 figures count parent-agent requests during user dialogue. Trace-wide model HTTP totals including startup were 78/67; the 26/21 non-parent requests are not attributed to this change. All 104 parent responses across the 15 attempts were HTTP 200, logically complete and recorded without an error.

Planned 16 attempts; the predefined $4.5 soft budget stop prevented the last new-arm attempt from being sent. All **15 executed attempts passed exact file-byte and collateral-file grading** and have confirmed session.delete/metadata-NOT_FOUND receipts. The extra old-arm attempt is retained in the data but excluded from paired request/token totals. No failures or outliers were replaced. The key was revoked (401), and owned Pod/ConfigMap/Secret deletion was confirmed. These are targeted synthetic mechanism tasks, not an official benchmark or production error-rate estimate.

## Evidence

![Paired cwd-guidance validation](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/b4c55d4aeb662dfb8a1ce188bcec5af0e76d8921/docs/developer_guide/evidence/tool-mcp-fixes-2026-11-05/cwd-guidance/validation.png?raw=true)

[Open validation image](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/b4c55d4aeb662dfb8a1ce188bcec5af0e76d8921/docs/developer_guide/evidence/tool-mcp-fixes-2026-11-05/cwd-guidance/validation.png) · [All attempt metrics, paired results and source hashes](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/b4c55d4aeb662dfb8a1ce188bcec5af0e76d8921/docs/developer_guide/evidence/tool-mcp-fixes-2026-11-05/cwd-guidance/paired-results.json)

The image is generated from the actual archived receipts. It uses GitHub's same-site authenticated file route for this private repository; browser rendering has not been independently verified. Essential numbers are included as text above.

No matching issue was opened; the trigger was isolated performance-trajectory analysis. Grep formatting and default file-read strategy are separate work. This is a ready-for-review PR; no merge or production deployment performed.


Repository evidence context: [methods, limits and relative image links](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/b4c55d4aeb662dfb8a1ce188bcec5af0e76d8921/docs/developer_guide/evidence/tool-mcp-fixes-2026-11-05/cwd-guidance/README.md). This note is indexed from the Developer Guide; runtime code and model-study data were not changed by this evidence reorganization.

## Additional ledger pair

A separate frozen old/new pair both passed exact-byte and collateral-file grading. Parent model requests were **7 → 7**, input tokens **209,148 → 209,939 (+0.38%)**. Neither arm made an implicit-limit `read_file` call; the new arm read only **8 lines / 349 bytes**, after one read-before-edit rejection. This did not reproduce the earlier broad-read inflation, but one pair cannot establish prompt causality or its probability. The original seven-pair **+18.7%** result above remains unchanged. Wall times (40.105 / 26.956 seconds) are descriptive only. Both session API cleanups, key revocation (401), and owned Pod/ConfigMap/Secret deletion were confirmed.

[Additional-pair metrics, exact grading and tool-reply sizes](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/b4c55d4aeb662dfb8a1ce188bcec5af0e76d8921/docs/developer_guide/evidence/tool-mcp-fixes-2026-11-05/cwd-guidance/recheck-results.json). No runtime code changes or extra model tasks accompanied this evidence update.

## 变更内容

### 门禁分层

- PR 打开/更新时只跑 `node-ut` 和 `hypium-ut`（Code Check 由单独 workflow 运行），设备 ST 不再随每个 PR 自动运行。
- 新增 `labeled` 事件：PR 打上 `pr-ready` 标签后重跑单测，单测通过后才启动 `st`；标签存在时后续 push 也会重新验证 ST。
- 去掉 CI job check 名里的 `pr-ready-` 前缀：`node-ut` / `hypium-ut` / `st` / `gate-report`。

### node-ut 双平台

- 默认在 Windows `hypium-windows` 运行，可用仓库变量 `CI_NODE_UT_RUNS_ON` 切回 Linux `dm-nodeut`。
- Windows 上从华为镜像引导 Node 22.13（nodejs.org 兜底）、`npm install` 测试依赖，并通过 npmmirror 安装 Playwright Chromium；新增 `scripts/ci/node-ut.ps1` 负责发现用例、采集 V8 覆盖率和阈值门禁。
- Windows 跳过两个依赖 `/bin/sh` 的 Linux 主机日志采集测试（`collect-cloud-logs`、`collect-profiling`），其余测试完整运行。
- 签名配置检查抽成 `scripts/ci/check-signing-config.cjs`，Linux/Windows 共用。
- 跨平台修复：`coverage-gate.mjs` 的路径分隔符归一化、`use-owned-runtime.mjs` 的 `file:` 路径统一为 `/`、`agc-sms-server.mjs` 在 Windows 跳过目录 fsync、两个测试对 CRLF 更健壮、Windows 跳过不适用的 POSIX 文件权限断言。

### gate-report 双平台

- 默认 Windows `hypium-windows`，可用 `CI_REPORT_RUNS_ON` 切到 Linux `dm-utility`。
- 下载、合并和汇总步骤按 `runner.os` 选择 bash/PowerShell；Windows 优先使用已有 Node，没有时按 node-ut 同样的镜像方式引导。
- Windows 下载 base 快照时动态解析 Git 的 GNU tar；在只有 `D:\Tools\Git`、没有 DevEco 的 `digitalmate-main-windows-01` 上也能处理中文文件名和长路径。

## 验证

- 本地完整单测：2546 通过、2 skipped；唯一失败为本地缺 `ws` 模块，CI 镜像会预装 `ws@8.22.1`，与本次改动无关。
- 分支端到端验证（[run 42006854158](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42006854158)，`workflow_dispatch` 执行分支上的最终 workflow，commit `8727082a`）全部通过：
  - `node-ut`（Windows `digitalmate-main-windows-01`）：2630 个用例，2623 通过 / 0 失败 / 7 skipped，行覆盖率 78.4%（阈值 55%）。
  - `hypium-ut`、`st`：Windows 设备 runner 上均 success。
  - `gate-report`（同 `digitalmate-main-windows-01`）：success，验证了无 DevEco 时的 Node 引导和 GNU tar 解析。
- YAML 解析与 actionlint 通过（仅剩自建 runner label / shellcheck 既有告警）。

## 注意事项

- 仓库需存在 `pr-ready` 标签，首次使用前请确认。
- 若已配置 required checks，需要把旧的 `pr-ready-*` 名称更新为新的 check 名。
- Windows runner 需要能访问华为镜像 / npmmirror；如需换源可设置 `PLAYWRIGHT_DOWNLOAD_HOST` 仓库变量。
- `pull_request_target` 使用 base 分支的 workflow，因此 PR 自身的检查不会执行新的 `ci.yml`；本 PR 已用分支上的 `workflow_dispatch` 做过端到端验证。


## Issue 追溯关联
<!-- weekly-pr-backfill:2026-11-02:pr-gates -->
Refs #920 — [Feature]: 完善跨平台 PR 分层门禁、pr-ready 状态与 Code Check 取源.

此 Issue 按维护者要求补建，用于追踪已合入工作的需求、设计和验证记录；关联不代表本次重新测试或新增未修复问题。

## What

`agent-core` declared `transformers>=4.52.4` as a hard dependency. DigitalMate serves models through remote providers; the Hugging Face stack is only needed by local-model features (guardrail local backend, transformers-backed progressive retrieval, RL/SFT tokenizer helpers), all of which already import it lazily.

- Move `transformers` from `[project].dependencies` to the new `local-models` extra.
- Move the only eager import (`sft_verl_dataset.py` tokenizer types) behind `TYPE_CHECKING`.
- Record both customized files in `harness/UPSTREAM.json` (`import_overrides`, updated `imported_git_tree` and the modification note).

`install_runtime.py` builds the local agent-core wheel from `pyproject.toml`, so the wheel and the runtime image no longer pull `transformers` (or its Hugging Face Hub/tokenizers dependencies).

## Verification

- `python -B harness/verify_sources.py` → OK (agent-core imported tree `d4d37d42…`)
- `python -B -m unittest discover -s harness/tests` → 8 passed
- AST scan of `harness/agent-core/openjiuwen`: 0 module-level `transformers` imports outside `TYPE_CHECKING`
- Wheel build not run locally: this sandbox has no network and no cached `setuptools>=61`.

## Notes

- `harness/agent-core/uv.lock` is unchanged: DigitalMate's image build does not resolve it (it builds wheels from `pyproject.toml`). It should be regenerated upstream when convenient.
- `openjiuwen[local-models]` restores the previous install behaviour for local inference; `torch` remains caller-provided, as before.

585.body:
Refs #565

Adds and registers **7 E4 artifact and system integration cases**. The cases use file readback, cloud records, and system state to check artifact operations. Version records bind each workflow to its scorecard and archived evidence.

| Case | Coverage |
| --- | --- |
| `ATTACH-01` | Switch conversations and identities during upload; verify attachment ownership and cleanup. |
| `FILE-02` | Overwrite and publish at the same path; verify the actual write path, a single card, and preview content after recovery. |
| `FILE-03` | Retry manually after artifact delivery fails; verify retry count and the effective artifact version. |
| `FILE-04` | Generate, preview, and export a file; open it through the system file manager and compare the downloaded bytes exactly. |
| `FILEDELETE-01` | Refresh, reconnect, and restart after deletion; verify the deleted artifact remains absent and other artifacts remain available. |
| `PERM-01` | Read the same resource after authorization, revocation, and reauthorization; verify denial and recovery. |
| `REMINDER-01` | Query reminder and system alarm resources; verify creation, cancellation, and resource differences. |

### Verification recorded for this PR

- Commit `74101840` incorporated main at `e63ffd25`. The E1 and E4 cases, samples, and scorecards retained their existing definitions. Workflow contracts **28/28** and the daily baseline **1/1** passed. The local Node gate reported **2,788 passed**, 2 skipped, and **77.7%** line coverage.
- The default E2E output directory was separated from the source cleanliness check. Regression checks allowed default output while newly added source still triggered C2.
- An additional `FILE-04` device run read the actual filename from the device directory and recovered **49 bytes**, exactly matching the request. Six assertions passed. Wrong-name and extra-newline counterexamples both failed as intended. [Raw file and record](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/fed6fc7f214f7e1de586b37d0fa37b2bb2038153/tests/e2e/results/e4-file04-device-name-20261105/DM-WF-FILE-04/evidence.json) · [System readback screenshot](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/fed6fc7f214f7e1de586b37d0fa37b2bb2038153/tests/e2e/results/e4-file04-device-name-20261105/DM-WF-FILE-04/screenshots/14-checkpoint.png)
- `ATTACH-01` completed two actual picker, upload, and removal rounds on the same installation. The source PNG contained 1,802 bytes. A wrong-name counterexample failed in round 2. The historical screenshot scores were 4/5 in both rounds. Conversation and identity switching were not executed. [Round 1](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/6fba61a30fd9b559c8ef92d4b848ba5887c81211/tests/e2e/results/e4-attach-picker-repeat-20261105/round-1/DM-WF-ATTACH-01/evidence.json) · [Round 2 and screenshots](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/6fba61a30fd9b559c8ef92d4b848ba5887c81211/tests/e2e/results/e4-attach-picker-repeat-20261105/round-2/DM-WF-ATTACH-01/evidence.json)
- `FILE-02` produced a completed cloud task and one same-name card. The loaded preview and 87-byte source receipt still matched the first revision. Version 3 waits for the conversation to become idle and the preview to finish loading. Its local retry submitted once, then stopped at `S04`: the cloud root task was `failed` with `ValueError`, with zero artifacts. The two write traces and complete v3 acceptance were not verified. [Original preview](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/941a2815ad70e0961f84221a8baa4f61167671a6/tests/e2e/results/e4-file02-overwrite-20261105/DM-WF-FILE-02/first-version-preview.png) · [Raw receipt](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/941a2815ad70e0961f84221a8baa4f61167671a6/tests/e2e/results/e4-file02-overwrite-20261105/DM-WF-FILE-02/actual-artifact-receipt.txt) · [Run record](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/941a2815ad70e0961f84221a8baa4f61167671a6/tests/e2e/results/e4-file02-overwrite-20261105/DM-WF-FILE-02/evidence.json)
- The default daily batch retained the original FILE-02 workflow. Explicit selection runs the current version and its preflight checks.
- The driver locates failure messages within the current turn, matches cards by their actual filename, and retains the control file during deletion checks. Regression checks reproduced the first two driver defects before the fixes and passed afterward.
- Two further `FILE-04` rounds on the same emulator build completed generation, preview, system save, and external readback. Each passed six assertions and recovered **46 bytes** exactly. Both rejected an expected value containing an extra newline. Their historical local AI scores were **4/5**; the lists truncated long names, and the saved screenshots did not retain a clear save confirmation.

588.author: huben0423-hw
588.body:
## Summary

Makes the runtime dependencies that DigitalMate never starts optional. The image now installs only what the default path uses; everything else lives behind an extra and is imported on first use.

This PR folds #584 (transformers) into #588 so the dependency trim lands as one review.

| Component | Removed from default install | Now behind |
| --- | --- | --- |
| agent-core | transformers | `openjiuwen[local-models]` |
| workswarm | python-telegram-bot, discord.py, slack-bolt, dingtalk-stream, wecom-aibot-sdk, lark-oapi | `workswarm[im-channels]` |
| workswarm | google-genai | `workswarm[google-ai]` |
| workswarm | playwright | `workswarm[browser]` |
| workswarm | chromadb, faiss-cpu | `workswarm[vector-backends]` |
| workswarm | google-adk, google-api-core | dropped — nothing imports or needs them |
| agent-core | pymilvus | `openjiuwen[milvus]` |
| agent-core | anthropic, dashscope | `openjiuwen[model-providers]` |
| agent-core | matplotlib, mermaid-py | `openjiuwen[charts]` |
| agent-core | pyoxigraph | `openjiuwen[ontology]` |
| agent-core | docx2txt, cacheout | dropped — nothing imports them |

## Why the default path stays intact

- Reachability was checked by parsing every module-level import in both packages and doing a transitive closure from the real entry points (`jiuwenswarm.server.app_agentserver`, `jiuwenswarm.server.agent_ws_server`, `jiuwenswarm.gateway.app_gateway`). After these changes the closure contains **zero** module-level imports of any removed package.
- `transformers` is used only by local-model features (guardrail local backend, transformers-backed progressive retrieval, RL/SFT tokenizer helpers), all of which already import it lazily. The only eager import (the veRL SFT dataset tokenizer types) is now behind `TYPE_CHECKING`.
- `gateway/channel_manager/__init__.py` resolves IM channel classes through PEP 562 `__getattr__`, so a channel SDK is imported only when that channel is first used. `app_gateway` already imported each platform module lazily.
- `image_tools.py` imports `google.genai` inside `_invoke_gemini_vision`.
- `checkpointer/inmemory.py` had an unused `pymilvus` import on the startup path; it is removed. `MilvusConnector` imports `pymilvus.utility` at its three call sites.
- `dashscope_embedding.py` now imports the SDK only when it builds a request. This matters because `openjiuwen.core.retrieval.lazy_load._load_openai()` imports that module for every OpenAI/VLLM embedding lookup, so a module-level `import dashscope` would have made DashScope mandatory for OpenAI embeddings.
- `mermaid` was already behind a `try/except ModuleNotFoundError` guard; `matplotlib` is only imported inside functions.
- `agentdescent` and `gitcode-api` stay base dependencies: `openjiuwen.rsi` imports them at module level, and that package is loaded from the workswarm auto-harness path.
- `openjiuwen[all]` / `all-vector` now include the new extras so a full install still installs what used to be unconditional.
- `harness/UPSTREAM.json` records every customized file and the recomputed imported Git trees for both components.

Behaviour change to note: a deployment that enables an IM channel, the Gemini vision backend, a local model or an external vector backend must install the matching extra; nothing else changes. The DigitalMate image builds only the base wheels, so image/video generation continues to use the HTTP-based `visual_gen`/`video_gen` paths, not the DashScope SDK.

## Verification

- `python -B harness/verify_sources.py` — both components OK (manifests, overrides, recomputed imported Git trees).
- Module-level import audit from the startup entry points — 0 imports of the removed packages.
- `python -B -m unittest discover -s harness/tests` — merged with current `main`; the only errors in this sandbox are four `test_tool_index_reuse` cases importing `pydantic`, which is not installed here. Those tests are unrelated to this change.
- Docker-level wheel build was not run locally (the environment has no working build backend); CI/image build will exercise it.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

## 连接故障

DigitalMate 的会话探测最多等待 25 秒，总恢复预算仍为 45 秒。单次超时先关闭探测连接，再重试。凭据验证仍使用受保护的 `room.home`。

## 验证

- 两项回归在基线失败，修复后通过。覆盖迟于旧时限的有效响应，以及超时连接先关闭再重试。

- 在独立的本地验证构建中，通过 TLS 透传隧道切断当前连接并暂停 15 秒。隧道恢复约 1.1 秒后，App 自行建立新连接并恢复对话输入。再次发送一条带新标记的消息，收到匹配回复。

593.author: Jianyu010
593.body:
## Problem and change

A retry must recover the same product session and run after admission, including after restart; acknowledging before all writes commit can lose the submission. This introduces a Router → Session Manager → SQLite Store proxy path with scoped identity, transactional admission, original profile binding, explicit New/Continue and agent/model path, optimistic context revisions, atomic run-bound context and final writes, and persisted submission stop intents. It appends the user text once as part of admission.

## Evidence

| Requirement | Test and command | Result | Remaining gap |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input validation and routing forwarding | `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/server/router/ut -v` | 2 passed | Proximity selection and user-facing policy remain to integrate |
| Durable admission, duplicate/conflict, scoped continuation, reopen, concurrent submissions and rollback | `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/server/agent_service/session_store/st -v` | 9 passed | Tests use real temporary SQLite and local Router/Manager; no Runtime or device |
| Revision conflict, durable final and failure, stop owner isolation | Same ST command | Included in 9 passed | Full control state machine, cancellation, late steer and terminal races remain open |
| Existing agent-call regression | `./scripts/test-agent-service` | 2 passed | Existing fake final writer is not wired to this Store |

The schema is a first-slice schema with no migration from old WorkSwarm databases; reopen is exercised by creating a new Store against the same temporary path. The old proximity behavior informed identity/conflict and scoped admission decisions; old EngineService task IDs, projection and execution adapters were not ported. EPHEMERAL/capacity, live/offloaded/archive recovery, pinned version resolution and real Core history are not implemented. SQLite calls are synchronous and need an async-safe execution boundary in Runtime assembly. A profile is currently a string; structured version bindings and input serialization need the lane 01 contract. The Host must stage final context and call `commit_turn(scope, session_id, run_id, expected_revision, messages, answer)` rather than independently committing a final answer. The durable stop intent resolves ownership only and does not cancel a run or establish a terminal state. This draft requires integration and review before merge.

Base: `aab978c45da387a207e90f59dcaf5aa6df1e571e`. Head: `25ec5de1a9dbec6beb7ad2aa9341e322c92a28d7`.

595.author: Jianyu010
595.body:
## Problem and change

An explicit mobile reply must continue its referenced session, while a new unanchored message needs an explicit continuity decision. A run must also retain the context at its own admission: if B is admitted to the same session before A starts, A must not mistake B for its input.

The Router resolves explicit reply anchors before using an injected classifier, rejects missing or ambiguous references and classifier choices outside its candidates, and checks duplicate submission identity before classification. The Store saves an immutable revision and start context per run in the admission transaction. The existing revision check rejects an A final commit after B changes session context rather than overwriting B.

## Dependency and evidence

**Draft:** #593 merged as `0d66510022dd7fe142725cdc68a9fc2142bf8d45`. Merged that base into the branch without rewriting remote history and repeated the tests below. Base remains `codex/architecture-foundation`. Head: `1482e3213e9a4116d0a9177f5dd18a6c755d8e35`.

| Requirement | Command | Result | Gap |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Explicit reply, fake classifier New/Continue, invalid targets | `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/server/router/ut -v` | 5 passed | Real scoped candidate reader and model classifier absent |

598.author: Jianyu010
598.body:
## Problem and behavior

A stop for B can arrive before B's admission receipt while A and C run independently. The Store now persists a run claim and arbitrates completion against confirmed cancellation at the SQLite transaction boundary. B remains admitted, but a pending stop makes its first claim return `cancelled`, without a start permit. For an active run, stop records `stop_requested`; only the host's confirmation of actual quiescence writes `cancelled`. A committed final answer and confirmed cancellation are mutually exclusive: the first durable terminal wins.

The Manager proxy exposes `claim_run(scope, run_id)`, `stop_submission(scope, submission_id)` and `confirm_stopped(scope, run_id)`. Only a `claimed` result permits initial dispatch. Existing `running`, `stop_requested`, `completed`, `cancelled` and historical `unknown` outcomes do not grant another permit. `stop_submission` returns `pending` before admission and `stop_pending` for an admitted run awaiting claim. `commit_turn` requires a claimed run and raises `RunTerminal` if cancellation won. The host is responsible for delivering a stop and confirming actual quiescence, authorization, and reconciling an interrupted execution whose status is unknown.

## Dependency and evidence

**Draft; blocked on #595**, tested dependency `1482e3213e9a4116d0a9177f5dd18a6c755d8e35`. Base is `codex/architecture-foundation`; this branch contains the unmerged dependency until it lands. Merge the updated base and repeat tests after that. Head: `36ee776d630c93b2aba9cefc004ccb31369c7281`.

| Requirement | Command | Actual result | Gap |

| Router rules | `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/server/router/ut -v` | 5 passed | Fake classifier and candidate list |
| Early and active stop, A/B/C isolation, replay/reopen, concurrent terminal race, migrations | `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/server/agent_service/session_store/st -v` | 19 passed with real SQLite | No real executor, Runtime or device |
| Existing AgentCall regression | `./scripts/test-agent-service` | 2 passed | Host is not wired to these control methods |

Migration from the previous schema marks historical runs with an answer completed and incomplete historical runs unknown, never automatically dispatching them. Historical runs predating start snapshots remain explicitly unavailable for start-context recovery. Running claims persist across restart and are not reissued: this avoids duplicate dispatch but does not establish whether a crashed executor ran, nor provide a recovery lease. Supplements/answers targeting an existing run, external side effects, run failure states and cancellation authorization remain open.
